# [Debbie Stabenow Just Endorsed Me](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=196707664&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk2NzA3NjY0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzgxMTIyMDYsImV4cCI6MTc4MDcwNDIwNiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.WjXoDearNyvvHdxycXfS3K3sRpa_mo0_hwXgb95nYqA)
### I'm honored to have the support of one of Michigan's greatest champions.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| May 7
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..LtwgBCk-ondmOGuXs9p7nlgi8a0BQqMJ-0Z-Ajy63U8?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/debbie-stabenow-just-endorsed-me?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

**I 'm honored to share that former U.S. Senator Debbie Stabenow has endorsed me for the U.S. Senate in Michigan.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0e212780-8190-4ce3-b7e8-69d9a6167acc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I truly could not ask for a more meaningful endorsement. If you're not from here, you may not know this, but no one knows Michigan like Debbie Stabenow.
Not only was Senator Stabenow the first woman elected to the U.S. Senate from Michigan, she is also one of the most respected leaders our state has ever seen.
She spent five decades serving Michiganders in elected office and met every challenge with grit, competence, and a deep understanding of the people who call this state home.
She unapologetically fought for Michigan manufacturing. She stood up for our farmers. She protected the Great Lakes and our clean water.
She knew how to get things done. She delivered results, and she did it without ever losing sight of the people behind the policies.
That's why I admire her so much, and why I'm so grateful for her support.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/86ea7190-9112-4adf-8be6-abd1fe02149f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I've known Senator Stabenow since we worked together during President Obama's auto rescue, when we helped save more than 200,000 Michigan jobs. She understood what that moment meant for our state. She understood that the auto industry is not just a line item in an economic report - it is families, communities, and generations of Michigan pride.
She has always understood the Michigan way.
That's why I was so moved by what she said when she endorsed me: **" Haley has the track record and the Michigan grit to lower costs and get things done for Michigan families."**
That means a lot coming from Debbie Stabenow. Because she knows what it takes to fight - and she knows what it takes to win.
Senator Stabenow understands that the stakes are high in this battleground race. Senate control could come down to Michigan, and the polls consistently show I'm the Democrat with the best chance at defeating Mike Rogers.
Friend, this is not just another election. This is a turning point for our state. Costs are too high. Working families are struggling. And Republicans are focused on pleasing Trump and their MAGA billionaire donors - while doing next to nothing to help regular folks who can't afford the basics.
This is a serious moment, and it requires serious leaders.
**To have Senator Stabenow say she believes I 'm ready for this work - ready to continue her fight, ready to deliver for families, ready to meet this moment - is incredibly humbling.**
And motivating.
Because I believe in the same kind of politics she practiced: one rooted in service, in results, and in never forgetting the Michiganders who sent you there in the first place.
I'm not running for Senate to make speeches or go viral. I'm running to fight for this state I love.
To lower costs.
To create jobs.
To protect manufacturing.
To stand up for workers.
To make government work for all Michiganders, not just the wealthy and well-connected.
That is the work. And Debbie Stabenow has been one of Michigan's greatest examples of how to do it.
**So yes, I am so proud of this endorsement. But more than that, I am grateful for her example. For her trust. For the path she helped pave. And I 'm more fired up than ever to win.**
If you're in a position to chip in, I'd be grateful for that too. Truly. We're building a grassroots campaign, so every dollar helps. **[Will you help us take on Mike Rogers and keep Michigan blue?](https://substack.com/redirect/86ea7190-9112-4adf-8be6-abd1fe02149f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/86ea7190-9112-4adf-8be6-abd1fe02149f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you, Senator Stabenow. We won't let you down.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/86ea7190-9112-4adf-8be6-abd1fe02149f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Dan Cox
subject: Opened your electric bill yet?
body:
Maryland families are paying more—and it’s fixable.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/coxforcongress/something-happened-this-week-6754375?e=5bb5efcda7)
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

,
Maryland families are paying some of the highest electric bills in our region—and it didn’t have to be this way.
While states like Virginia and West Virginia continue to produce more of their own power, Maryland has become increasingly dependent on energy from outside the state. At the same time, demand is rising fast, especially with the growth of data centers across the PJM grid.
The result? **Higher costs for you.**
And it’s about to get worse.
More in-state power plants are scheduled to shut down in the coming years, which means even less local supply and even more pressure on prices.
We don’t need to accept that.
I have a plan to bring costs down and restore energy stability in Maryland:
* Bring reliable power generation back online where possible
* Expand cleaner natural gas capacity and modernize existing infrastructure
* Advance small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs)
* Require large-scale energy users, like data centers, to carry more of their own load

This is about one thing: **lowering your electric bill and protecting Maryland families from rising costs.**
If you’re ready for a different direction, **join me today at**[**DanCoxforGovernor.com**](https://us.list-manage.com/tQK64djys5B?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
I’d be honored to earn your vote.

For nearly a century, federal law has prohibited the unregulated shipment of handguns through the United States Postal Service to protect public safety.
But the Trump administration has decided they don’t think the law should apply anymore — and then directed USPS to make up their own policy to allow anyone to mail handguns across and within state lines, without the involvement of a firearm dealer.
Once again, the Trump administration is disregarding the safety of the people it is sworn to serve. We cannot and will not ignore the dangerous consequences of this proposed rule that puts our communities at risk.
It’s reckless and illegal – and we’re fighting back. Will you chip in to help power this work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
This administration cannot just unilaterally tell the USPS to violate a valid federal law — so I co-led a coalition of 22 attorneys general in submitting a formal comment letter making clear that the proposed new rule is unlawful and would make our communities less safe.
Under the Trump administration’s preferred policy, people who are legally prohibited from owning a firearm — like felons and domestic abusers — could have a handgun shipped directly through the mail, bypassing safeguards that exist to keep weapons out of dangerous hands.
And at a time when budgets are already under pressure, this rule would make it even harder and more expensive for law enforcement to trace illegal firearms and solve gun crimes.
The Trump administration has made clear it will dismantle gun safety laws piece by piece if no one pushes back. We are pushing back — and we need your support to keep doing it.

[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260506_3_ak.Fo_TcN&refcode=em20260506-41284&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41284%2E3422442%2E4o1gok)
Peter,
I just got off the debate stage, and if there’s one thing I want people to know, it’s this: **this race is about who you think the government should work for.**
Too many people who were up on tonight’s stage are comfortable with the system as it is. _I’m not._
Families in California are doing everything right and _are still falling behind._ Rent is up, groceries are up, wages aren’t keeping pace. And while that’s happening, the people with money and power are doing just fine.
I’ve seen this up close my whole career. And I’ve sat at my kitchen table doing the math, trying to make it work when it doesn’t. That’s not abstract for me. It’s real life for a lot of people.
My agenda is simple: **lower costs, take on the companies and interests driving them up, and hold the government accountable so we can actually deliver for Californians.**
This isn’t about who has the biggest corporations backing them or the most money. It’s about who’s willing to do the work and take on the fights that come with it.
The June primary is less than a month away, ballots are already in mailboxes across the state, and only the top two candidates make it to November.
**[If you’re with me, I’d be honored if you donated $5 or whatever you can to my campaign today. Together, we can build on tonight’s momentum and make sure our message reaches voters across the state.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260506_3_ak.Fo_TcN&refcode=em20260506-41284&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=41284%2E3422442%2E4o1gok)**

Katie

clean_body: Peter, I just got off the debate stage, and if there’s one thing I want people to know, it’s this: this race is about who you think the government should work for. Too many people who were up on tonight’s stage are comfortable with the system as it is. I’m not. Families in California are doing everything right and are still falling behind. Rent is up, groceries are up, wages aren’t keeping pace. And while that’s happening, the people with money and power are doing just fine. I’ve seen this up close my whole career. And I’ve sat at my kitchen table doing the math, trying to make it work when it doesn’t. That’s not abstract for me. It’s real life for a lot of people. My agenda is simple: lower costs, take on the companies and interests driving them up, and hold the government accountable so we can actually deliver for Californians. This isn’t about who has the biggest corporations backing them or the most money. It’s about who’s willing to do the work and take on the fights that come with it. The June primary is less than a month away, ballots are already in mailboxes across the state, and only the top two candidates make it to November. Thank you, Katie Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change.

name: The PreBorn! Team
subject: This is a different kind of Mother's Day
body:
This Mother’s Day, while many of us are celebrating the women who gave us life, there are women quietly deciding if they will become mothers at all.

| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbt9rmfpuug305k5q0r6sok7fhhu83dish0fv3i8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgm9o72c3h2bs)
---
Friend of Life, She’s sitting in her car, staring at the building in front of her, trying to convince herself this is the only way forward, even though something inside her keeps saying, _wait... just wait._ She tells herself she doesn’t have time to think. That if she slows down, she might not be able to go through with it. That it’s easier to just move forward with the abortion and deal with everything else later. No one has told her she can pause. No one has told her she can see her baby first. And if nothing interrupts this moment, her decision will be made in minutes. This is the reality for thousands of women right now. And it’s why this moment matters so much. Because when a woman is given the chance to see her baby on an ultrasound, something begins to change in a way that is hard to describe until you see it happen. The screen lights up, the heartbeat fills the room, and suddenly what felt distant and abstract becomes real. She’s no longer thinking about “getting through something.” She’s looking at her child. And in that moment, everything shifts. [**More than 80% of women choose life after seeing their baby on an ultrasound.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbh64e0bdhff5nn5kpklv71d64mqk5nmkoqq17t8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgm9o72c3h2bs) But what matters just as much is what happens after. subject: They Don’t Think West Virginia Will Show Up
body:
| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/56c35bf07001/they-dont-think-west-virginia-will-show-up?e=a0285cc040)

# They Don’t Think West Virginia
# Will Show Up

---
|
---
|
---
| |
Dear Friend,
**West Virginia doesn’t need to be fixed.**
**It needs to be unleashed.**
We have the hardest-working people in America.
Natural resources that power this country.
Communities built on faith, family, and trust.
**What we don’t have is leadership that puts us first.**
That has got to change!
I believe in a simple vision:
**Put West Virginia first.**
Protect our freedoms.
Grow our economy.
Defend our values.
Not Washington’s agenda.
Not outside interests.
Not policies that leave our people behind.
**And the contrast in this race couldn’t be clearer.**
Shelley Moore Capito earned an [**F rating from Liberty Score’s conservative review**](https://tomwillis.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3634ddeac3944e116590ee972&id=96b65a38e2&e=a0285cc040)**.**
According to that scorecard, she voted with the liberal position **57.1% of the time** and aligned with conservative positions only **42.9% of the time.**
And it doesn't end there — she has also received **F ratings for conservative voting from CPAC, FreedomWorks, and Heritage Action.**
**That’s not West Virginia.**
**That’s not our values.****
**But make no mistake — this race is about more than policy.
She has the money.
She has the name recognition.
**She’s been part of the Washington establishment for a quarter century.**
And the establishment is counting on one thing:
**They think this race is already decided.**
They think your vote doesn’t matter.
They think nothing will ever change.
**But they’re wrong.**
This campaign isn’t about the political establishment.**
It’s about you — the good people of West Virginia.**
I’ve beaten the establishment before.
**And with your help, we’ll do it again.**
**When you trust the people and get the government out of the way,****West Virginians always rise.**
This is how we take our state back.
**Vote Tom Willis on May 12.**
**IT’S TIME FOR A CHANGE WV.**
Sincerely,
**Tom Willis**

## US, Iran Closing In on Peace Memo
The White House said Wednesday it is [closing in on an agreement](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkEGq3DAMQE_j7DQ4jhPnL7KYUkKh_G666DJoYjmj4tjBdiad2xf3CgWt9EDovV-fyyey57D9wJ2m4uIS6MqeSqG0HLFQKIyeEwZL6AvZcqZAi5JqANmDNItF9u9FN3ZyRIq6hqbWmLHVozaqeU7aDLpvexzxsQ7j48ON64N0b5Szqjfj0PBUr8lemlZKo8fb0PUf1lhtbTc406LQkiyXmG6_I4fyJOff8UXptsa98dOzlCOL7i7ULNR8Xddtz6EyoWYKcGah5ipVYUze1vWf1Z-ZXwRnBgwWqiCsPmYOG3CAWIfgwI1gpz1CiUDBwoUJonO8MvoMGd9CzZjgflfq_F6-iW6OK1vRff1Sk9KVf1I6mjTZ42LvOQ9GaLntyP7f8-W_ir8m9TcAAP__5GKWyg) with Iran on a one-page memo that would formally end the 68-day war, with officials expecting Tehran's response within 48 hours. The 14-point framework would trigger [30 days of talks](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOrDAMRb8GuqBgQgJFitfQzWu3RBlshqxCgoIZNH-_yv7CNpalK52rc78e88P54OPrv9vJ8prmSPcZiJnyfCSmyN4Fn11EcoEJ-cqRZpCgheyFNDM6Hz6zqtGuREBdTbY1ZmjVoAzUm30qGOCJuh8GHB0RrTiOWoLWi-wN6NrbQpO9NK2URg2N7voRDSrETq-mdZWShJ5Tbr6Tj7zRGj7pTblZ0l4HuzEfZ9X9q2CqYLrvu1nicylhBVNBVzDJvpzyXacoNuIgt5AoUiJeSyCXxZ6y45T9tTcb76HOFo_bh-BPbSolX7vz4beT_zTU28JPAAAA__-vo3vJ) to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, lift U.S. sanctions, and impose a years-long moratorium on Iranian uranium enrichment. President Trump on Tuesday night [paused Project Freedom](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAQheGngc4RjDH4FhTbuMu2W1okM8REGBCeJMrbr5JXuPXR-Yr_33k9h5RTuf0NO3mOdS30OjIxU19bZSqcQk49FKSQmZAfvdAKCuygpkG5FUPK79VI9JEIaJTktXOzNrNxIDePAJP9gRG0vSg0zgUAMmO4UIhoNcnkP5qalNNKOTOf7Dj9oEODONrodBBGESau_XSvqfBGMb_rk_rpWneZ_cbcDjH-EbAIWHijLeX82QQsreZ0fQtYkCKVgwQs02wnpWHg_tjb0MLjoGNovd7pykPsRPh9yu6xvVLO6bBOGHXbQ_qqkn-V6enhfwAAAP__Zg18CA), the U.S. naval mission to escort ships through the strait. He warned bombing would resume "at a much higher level" if Iran rejects the deal. Even with talks underway, fighting continued. A U.S. fighter jet [struck an Iranian oil tanker](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OgzAQBeDTQOdo8A-2CxfbpMu2W6KBGYJXxiDjJMrtV-QKW45Genrf-7kNN4wp5vs3rhzqvA2ZX0fiWrkM-1Y514gpFszEmCpTfZTMgwTZCzAC7EAY03vQLYWZWbJqOXTWuk47bWW7BKXIG7BqNihHI0GhJes6Myov2Y6yjeFMAwO2A7DaXXplPFnSRKqfbYeNBqZYt3L53WKuC8_pvT25XKZtbVNYat2PRn018trIK-4n4HydR6lxStzI6ykQj0PEoyAn8cIipiVmFCu-RS8-HkXQd-hhmojBm8468qN3jrwmcLNqS6D9FVOKR28bDfcVY_qUqP9a7hnkXwAAAP__Kz1_Vw) trying to break the American blockade Wednesday, and Israel hit Beirut for the first time since last month's Hezbollah ceasefire.
## Feds Sue NYT For Race, Gender Bias
The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission sued the _New York Times_ on Tuesday, alleging the paper [bypassed a white male editor for promotion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb_G7rAwYOMtKLZxl223tAgzJPMehggmsfL3T84vvO5IozlX9_6_bBdPifLtn9_RcSxbxqMlZMa6PQpjZvKJqs-APjECP2vGTUk1CzkJaTfwlN6b6cFFRIW6Rzdau4xmMVb1dzeFBWcI0diwgL3KcNVy0qCMNjLEMfbkTpucpB2ltGYZZj39AQsGQM_Rjr4zEoG41OGrUOY7xvQuL6xDKHuf3J350Tr9t1Nrp9bjOIZwbWeL896p9cROrYgliPbEJjIe4l3qt2DasYlTJYBaqLRT9kwlC58S3j54vvbVweOglKjNtjPytntKn3T-1WQvp34CAAD___hDgvk) in favor of a less-qualified woman to meet its race and gender diversity goals. The 11-year veteran editor, who had extensive experience covering real estate, was cut from the final interview panel for the deputy real estate editor opening last year. The role went to an outside candidate the EEOC described as a non-white female with "[little to no experience](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFy6yAQRb9G6tAgQCAXFK9R59em1KzFYm-CwANrK_77jPMLaW9x55zzcV7PQIny9T_s6DmWNePREjJjXe-FMTNBogo5ICTGwI-acVVSWSEnId0agNJrNX3wEVGh7tGPzs2jmY1T_c2DnuQ22Wg1WhtBo7nM0dqL03Cybhx78u83OUk3SunMPFg9nYILJgRtoxuhMxIDcanDZ6HMN4zpVZ5Yh63sffI35nvr9L9OLZ1ajuMYEMs2XMuzU8vbppayd2p5r6I9sImMh3iV-iWYdmwiIImKCRiDqLChgBxEw28RqG2VdsrAVHJffbgflBI16zojrztQ-mXgP4V7evUTAAD__32chLU) in real estate journalism." The Tuesday filing fits a broader EEOC enforcement push. Under EEOC Chair Andrea Lucas, the agency has sued a Coca-Cola distributor over a women-only networking event and is investigating Nike's diversity hiring practices.
## Media Pioneer Ted Turner Dies at 87
Ted Turner, [the brash media mogul](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ_GdEb-A5PCxW3octstkc2Mk1k5JjKzQXn7FXmF7Y50pE_nfF_X5RqpUL39jw8MnLel4rEXZMa2PDfGyhQLtVgBY2EE_mkVF6PMKNUglV8gUnkvroOQEQ3aDoP2ftJuct509-Cs1WNyOeaUtF1Xq-MlDzFhck4lyB2Fk6YG5bVS3k39aIcLeHAAdsxeR-EUAvHW-u-NKt8xl_f2wtav26Mr4c783IX9J8wszHwcR7-m_Xxx9sLMZxRmZgT5Gd8kEO4y3lBOXq61CjN3LcDzoFJoH71w6vaIVD58_pOUVzC_AQAA___y4HbA) who launched CNN and reshaped American television, died Wednesday after a long battle with Lewy body dementia. He was 87. Turner, who won the nickname "The Mouth of the South" for his often off-color remarks, inherited his father's Atlanta billboard firm in 1963 and built it into a broadcasting empire, pioneering the "superstation" concept with WTBS and launching TBS, TNT, Cartoon Network, and Turner Classic Movies in the early days of cable. In 1980, Turner debuted CNN, [the first 24-hour cable news network](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiPbGEwKF9fQ5dor0cKukz05dmQ2QXn7X-QV_m5GI83om3_X5QqcON_-woOCxLJkOvZEIlSXZxHKwpC4QkaCJITyqpkWq-2o9KC0XxA4fRbXYohElvqWgvF-Mm5y3rb3AKsbLHiYxnG9kNfGoTEjrtaDdzG6lsPZpgftjdbeTd3YDxf06BD7MXoDjdOELKV2_wtnuVNMn_Km2m3l0aZwF3nuTf-nsXNj5-M4urxuJ8WZN3Y-ZWPnsrK8oDKdRgjVl6SqLWcVyysjVYVMu5q8qlsGd-lNWwM-D06J99E3Tt8ewOk7K7_66h3sTwAAAP__ZNV-fw), transforming how Americans and indeed the world consumed news. He sold Turner Broadcasting to Time Warner for $7.3 billion in 1996. Turner was an avid sportsman as well. name: Jim Jordan
subject: No one should ever accuse you of being a Democrat
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you!

After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Friend!
| Friend,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.

## Texas Man Identified as D.C. Shooting Suspect
A 45-year-old Midland man has been [identified](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO8yAQBeDT2B0WEGOSguJv3OVvt7QwM5iRsImAhOT2K-cKW00x0tP33s99uVuKdGz_7Y6mvn1aDmwlYq2Yl4pvW3Z7uGDzhkAHuBJSqrRILifGFeN6AUvxs4w9mJXDTfRohNZXoYQWsg_mAlp7bZUQK7jpIq4oV5y0tKvWzkvoyZxhXHEtBBdKDNOKE4zqBmrSnK-qGzkC1ZSHGvBL8vGTXpgHl_Y-mlDro3SXf52cOzm31gaf3meL89_J-Vk6Odu8I7DyLA90lbWQmI0RN4T4YSWkygq6jOfJL3LIkvfkMBd2oM2sBarIQnoWZAR4VPKEwL4YttujzwYejWKkMulu5NtuKX559W-jvoz8DQAA___JvJBC) as the suspect who shot at a Secret Service officer near the Washington Monument on Monday. According to the Department of Justice, Michael Marx was observed with a concealed weapon near the route of Vice President JD Vance's motorcade. When Secret Service agents [confronted](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAQRb8Gd3SgANEFi0km7no2k8ksDUKpJCgdIHb79y-a9wdvW5V7c879_xyfNsSwL3_shqZ-5jTu-C4Ra8U8VvzYstndrTYv6MPuXVlTqmEEBi1lijI9ehviOcrGm4n5njdouNYdV1xzaFYjepAWsMOOz20ve9fpDmFyAmwnheiaYK4yppjmnHHFH-2ErZeq96rVjE2KSIY-1JQfdcUbaY5nOjA_XNqaaNZaX4WIXwQGAoOd3GVw_QgM__4SGO4M3exOZ_SYbYwn_VaiBV3GSgvmIzikYT9SPK777bkvBIZSUz6JGIIn4jcXoLlUPWuy8a93iDGUVhPJls2GeBPVn-14GPgKAAD__xuUh00) him, he fled and fired at them, hitting a bystander. Marx was transported to a hospital after agents returned fire. In the ambulance, he allegedly [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u3CAURleDOyxgjLELijTuXtqU1h24YxPxM4I79szuozjZwas_6eic79fX-gUhhrz9hISW3o-yZjxbRCKsK-EbWoLsdqgb-pC9a3spFFYl1MiF5sKsHkL8rEPn7V34WXZopTGT1NJI1e12RlTC3W5q9A5Bm9nM0oAWj2nSE3jfBfsXJrQwUgqpZT_ecfSDnr0ejRB3zQaBPlCpPe14KT3ipxxYe1dSF-1O9Gzs9oOphanlPM_-96tRcNhv5WBqeTUo3DumlmdlarkIPEHm_7P4v6a88YauIvGG9QgOOWyYiWeEyk9oe8gblcxTya90DUChZIg8QYxdtf55hhhDGw0bxJYgxEuQvnfrYdWfAAAA__83DpBU), "F--- the White House," and repeatedly begged officers to "kill me." body:

| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zl2K1NMsIpj7Tdb93xKExgm70Ts8uFMn8JoO7Q7RpJOnDDNXsWtazG5J2Hggj75Kbr3BN0E8l5g6cIo2JM4ll7kPeJF0buGd4huCZYu7GJO3AHGxrBau19mfEZ7P4Mlw2QjY8CjSDB47CF6_1wK3SGBQBsgxuBwmWRANuLdbCGldtCMDYpmVVprBqMiO1eMYFu089eSCGYbZrzUPTdP-sbAljDdWoswdI-90KZg5gs4PX07YzwL-qQ==&c=a-4LiSKBhq4BEJS9iTnUqCiBqqD8bkxVXAekYUHsiPDwBbfUf0r3gg==&ch=LjZg0WrGcf89QHvntUg1ZmTbrrbxdge3wVSsXxBHtPHMrktoz9Pj-g==)
---
|
Peter,
The Supreme Court's decision gutting the Voting Rights Act just upended democracy as we know it. And nowhere are the stakes higher than the Georgia Supreme Court election on May 19:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zl2K1NMsIpj7Tdb93xKExgm70Ts8uFMn8JoO7Q7RpJOnDDNXsWtazG5J2Hggj75Kbr3BN0E8l5g6cIo2JM4ll7kPeJF0buGd4huCZYu7GJO3AHGxrBau19mfEZ7P4Mlw2QjY8CjSDB47CF6_1wK3SGBQBsgxuBwmWRANuLdbCGldtCMDYpmVVprBqMiO1eMYFu089eSCGYbZrzUPTdP-sbAljDdWoswdulK56IgZK5EyhTVjFtm45g==&c=a-4LiSKBhq4BEJS9iTnUqCiBqqD8bkxVXAekYUHsiPDwBbfUf0r3gg==&ch=LjZg0WrGcf89QHvntUg1ZmTbrrbxdge3wVSsXxBHtPHMrktoz9Pj-g==)
---
The Supreme Court just opened a Pandora's box of election lawsuits in Georgia. Who sits on that court when those cases are decided will determine whether Black voters have any protection left. This is the last line of defense.
MAGA Governor Brian Kemp has already announced the state will pursue an aggressive gerrymander to strip Black voters of representation and hand Republicans additional congressional seats before the 2028 election.
When Democrats challenge those rigged maps, those cases land in one place: the Georgia Supreme Court. And right now, MAGA holds the majority.
Two seats on the Georgia Supreme Court are on the ballot in just 12 days. | Friends, The Republican Primary is rapidly approaching! Early voting begins May 26th and the primary is June 9th. **I want to personally update you on everything happening across our campaign — because the momentum we’re building belongs to all of us.** Over the past several weeks, we’ve continued to see incredible support from leaders and grassroots conservatives across the Lowcountry. 75 local leaders have now endorsed our campaign, including Senator Larry Grooms, Sheriff PJ Tanner, Senator Tom Davis, Wade Malloch and Sidi Limehouse in the last few days! body:
This was a coordinated assault — a case manufactured by MAGA operatives and handed to a Supreme Court packed with partisan judges who were waiting for exactly this moment.
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hRbH4N6J3uixORlNVgvml_vg838eK4H9LmNrPaZeOqDfytl1wQUjrw1suaOHnmH3XlQBx6uQcemhqSKs0kWycd9HBwkVr1e8T1H451eVhcgXtlJBYp1T4I71vntOxP81x5-zIHjHmFauWt-2e4_7RT0eMtmKcKjLMrwfwNLo2xWs1olCIf4d0dpPAjjQ48fVwInNOStA5DL5mJZ2sLqsZpXe-uZMIQj8&c=kddAP9XgQtK0KIFKb2CzFq8gvdlrGKmX7_cAlYmQSP2EWABGFDfCvQ==&ch=DJpFAhyw8pXmNn21Z-7rZB1TzRGCkf6ukXOPxilBrgptS9YFtuEe4g==)
---
| Peter,
The Voting Rights Act is gutted. It took one carefully chosen plaintiff to make it happen. MAGA found their guy -- and now we know exactly who was at the center of it.
The case that destroyed sixty years of voting rights protections bears the name of a man from Brusly, Louisiana named Phillip "Bert" Callais. Hence Louisiana vs. Callais, the name of last week's devastating landmark Supreme Court case.
In the original court filing, he was described simply as a "non-African American voter" whose congressional district changed after Louisiana redrew its map. But Democracy Docket just published an exclusive investigation that revealed the background of Callais, and it's just what you would expect from MAGA:
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hRbH4N6J3uixORlNVgvml_vg838eK4H9LmNrPaZeOqDfytl1wQUjrw1suaOHnmH3XlQBx6uQcemhqSKs0kWycd9HBwkVr1e8T1H451eVhcgXtlJBYp1T4I71vntOxP81x5-zIHjHmFauWt-2e4_7RT0eMtmKcKjLMrwfwNLo2xWs1olCIf4d0dpPAjjQ48fVwInNOStA5DIevl2c01B62_4TZyjNpLwd&c=kddAP9XgQtK0KIFKb2CzFq8gvdlrGKmX7_cAlYmQSP2EWABGFDfCvQ==&ch=DJpFAhyw8pXmNn21Z-7rZB1TzRGCkf6ukXOPxilBrgptS9YFtuEe4g==)
---
Callais was at the Stop the Steal protest at the U.S. Capitol on January 6th, 2021. He has repeatedly called U.S. elections "rigged." He has promoted debunked conspiracy theories about noncitizen voting. He's called a CO election official convicted of a voting systems data breach a hero "for exposing the truth."
Days after the Supreme Court's ruling came down, a man the New York Times calls "a celebrity among election deniers" posted a photo shaking hands with Callais, calling him a "hero."
This was a coordinated assault -- a case manufactured by MAGA operatives and handed to a Supreme Court packed with partisan judges who were waiting for exactly this moment. The result: The largest rollback of Black representation in Congress in a generation. A coup by court.
And Louisiana's MAGA Governor Jeff Landry didn't waste a single day. The moment the ruling came down, he suspended Louisiana's ongoing May 16th congressional elections under a fake "state of emergency" -- with 42,000 ballots already cast. His goal is to eliminate up to two majority-Black congressional districts represented by Democrats before the 2026 midterms.
Louisiana is fighting back. The election suspension is being challenged in court. But court victories alone won't save us. We have to take this fight from the courtroom to the voting booth. That's what we're building -- organizers in all 4,000+ precincts, Democrats contesting every red seat on the map.
[But we're one of the least-funded Democratic parties in the nation. Republicans are counting on that. Will you rush a donation right now of $50, $25, $10, whatever you can to help Louisiana Democrats fight back?](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hRbH4N6J3uixORlNVgvml_vg838eK4H9LmNrPaZeOqDfytl1wQUjrw1suaOHnmH3Aw3y9GgMJrV1UH7UmRrMbg9uMi2VduRJttJHAjjCw778LAs1n_mLkFi1co_n2r-8A9VsNLKe_p25RKUXVZFh0Zk91rowKR35wQfP3UX4wYAWhJjG3JzIdccN1b2tj9nSgb_ZgSis3E89tqMGhQuLIAXu0_9oJ15EZfzxnksmu8E=&c=kddAP9XgQtK0KIFKb2CzFq8gvdlrGKmX7_cAlYmQSP2EWABGFDfCvQ==&ch=DJpFAhyw8pXmNn21Z-7rZB1TzRGCkf6ukXOPxilBrgptS9YFtuEe4g==)

Because it's Pennsylvania Small Business Week, I started thinking about all the small businesses I've loved growing up: Leiby's, Heisler's, Guers. Basically, ice cream and chocolate milk.
But you can't really talk about small business in Pennsylvania without talking about our farms. Especially our dairy farms.
Because right now, they're not being celebrated. They're struggling to survive.
Across Pennsylvania, family-owned dairy farms are closing. Families are selling their cows. Generations of work are gone. And it's not because they don't know what they're doing. It's not because they're not working hard enough.
It's because the math doesn't work.
It can cost around $30 a day to care for a cow and the milk might only bring in $20. That gap doesn't close with grit. It doesn't close with longer hours. It just widens. Add in rising costs for fertilizer, diesel, equipment repairs, and everything else farmers need just to keep going, and you start to see the reality they're facing.
These are families who name their cows. Who know their animals, their land, their craft. There's a relationship there, one that's good for the animals, good for the product, and good for all of us who rely on it.
But we're watching that way of life slip away. You can drive through parts of our district and pass five Dollar Generals in an hour. And that's not a knock on the people who shop there -- people make the best choices they can with what they have. **But zoom out for a second and ask: How is it that** _**this**_**is the system we 've built?**
**Where family farms -- central to Pennsylvania's identity -- are barely hanging on and Dollar Generals are multiplying. That doesn't add up.**
If Small Business Week is going to mean anything, it has to include the people who are feeding us. It has to include the farms that define our communities just as much as any storefront on Main Street.
So yes, support your local small businesses this week. But also, go a step further. Buy from a local farm. Seek out local dairy. Pay attention to where your food comes from.
And beyond that, we need to be honest about what's happening -- and do something about it. Because this is about protecting a way of life that still matters. It's about making sure these families can stay on their land and keep doing the work that sustains all of us.
I'm fighting for that.
For our farmers, for our local economies, and for a Pennsylvania where small businesses -- including the ones out in the fields -- actually have a fair shot.
Let's get to it.

clean_body: Because it's Pennsylvania Small Business Week, I started thinking about all the small businesses I've loved growing up: Leiby's, Heisler's, Guers. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more May 7 | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Because it's Pennsylvania Small Business Week, I started thinking about all the small businesses I've loved growing up: Leiby's, Heisler's, Guers. Basically, ice cream and chocolate milk. But you can't really talk about small business in Pennsylvania without talking about our farms. Especially our dairy farms. Because right now, they're not being celebrated. They're struggling to survive. Across Pennsylvania, family-owned dairy farms are closing. Families are selling their cows. Generations of work are gone. And it's not because they don't know what they're doing. It's not because they're not working hard enough. It's because the math doesn't work. It can cost around $30 a day to care for a cow and the milk might only bring in $20. That gap doesn't close with grit. It doesn't close with longer hours. It just widens. Add in rising costs for fertilizer, diesel, equipment repairs, and everything else farmers need just to keep going, and you start to see the reality they're facing. These are families who name their cows. Who know their animals, their land, their craft. There's a relationship there, one that's good for the animals, good for the product, and good for all of us who rely on it. But we're watching that way of life slip away. You can drive through parts of our district and pass five Dollar Generals in an hour. And that's not a knock on the people who shop there -- people make the best choices they can with what they have. But zoom out for a second and ask: How is it that thisis the system we 've built? Where family farms -- central to Pennsylvania's identity -- are barely hanging on and Dollar Generals are multiplying. That doesn't add up. If Small Business Week is going to mean anything, it has to include the people who are feeding us. It has to include the farms that define our communities just as much as any storefront on Main Street. So yes, support your local small businesses this week. But also, go a step further. Buy from a local farm. Seek out local dairy. Pay attention to where your food comes from. And beyond that, we need to be honest about what's happening -- and do something about it. Because this is about protecting a way of life that still matters. It's about making sure these families can stay on their land and keep doing the work that sustains all of us. I'm fighting for that. For our farmers, for our local economies, and for a Pennsylvania where small businesses -- including the ones out in the fields -- actually have a fair shot. Let's get to it. | | ---|---|--- Thanks for reading! Last year, Trump told us his ballroom would cost $100 million and be paid for by private donations.
#
Peter,
Last year, Trump told us his ballroom would cost $100 million and be paid for by private donations. Then the price increased to $200 million, then $250 million, and most recently $400 million — with at least some of it paid for by the American taxpayer.
Frankly, that ought to be bad enough to bring this thing to a full stop. And if you feel the same way, you’re not alone. Recent polling puts public support for the construction of this ballroom at under 30%.
But this week, MAGA made some changes to the pay-fors. **The price is $1 billion now, and it’s the American taxpayer footing the entire bill.** They hid that in the new Homeland Security budget, because apparently, they need a billion-dollar ballroom to keep the American people safe, and claim it has a military purpose. Oh, and they’re trying to force all of this through Congress silently on a party-line vote.
No. Not on our watch. They’re not getting a dime for this ballroom. Not if we have anything to say about it. We need every VoteVets supporter activated for this. If you’re against this ridiculous ballroom, we want to hear about it.

Peter Willis,

🚨🚨Republicans just unveiled a $72 BILLION bill crammed with billions more
to enable ICE to terrorize our communities. And they’ve added something
else: $1 billion to enable Trump’s pet ballroom project. 🚨🚨

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38186?source=email-20260507&t=1016&akid=10698%2E5885482%2E5Vh2ej ]Headline: Republicans seek $1bn in taxpayer cash for Trump's ballroom
project, once touted as privately funded.

If we don’t speak out now, our taxpayer dollars will bankroll Trump’s
vanity ballroom while supercharging ICE’s ability to infiltrate our
communities and rip apart families. Meanwhile, they’re slashing health
care and nutrition assistance.

We will not stand for it. And with outrage growing across the country, NOW
is our moment to overwhelm Congress with opposition and force them to
change course. Add your name now, and our messages will be sent straight
to Congress, while our Citizen Action Team delivers our call in person in
DC.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38186?source=email-20260507&t=1017&akid=10698%2E5885482%2E5Vh2ej ]Click here to demand Congress reject another cent for cruel ICE funding
and Trump’s ballroom.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38186?source=email-20260507&t=1018&akid=10698%2E5885482%2E5Vh2ej ]ADD YOUR NAME

While millions of Americans struggle to afford healthcare and food, this
bill hands tens of billions MORE to ICE, Customs and Border Protection,
and the Department of Homeland Security. And Republicans are refusing to
include ANY reforms to rein in ICE, so they’re planning to pass it using
the reconciliation process — without Democratic support.

Now, they’ve added in a gift to Trump: $1 billion for “security” for his
ballroom. That’s more than double the original $400 million price tag,
despite Trump’s public promise not a dime of your money would pay it.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38186?source=email-20260507&t=1019&akid=10698%2E5885482%2E5Vh2ej ]Headline: Republicans want to spend $1 billion in taxpayer money on
Trump's $400 million ballroom.

Public sentiment is crystal clear: a recent poll shows Americans oppose
the White House ballroom scheme by a 2-to-1 margin – even when they’re
told it’s privately funded. But now Congress expects all of us to pay for
it, while slashing programs working families rely on to survive.

Let’s call this what it is: a money grab for Trump’s ego, and a cash
injection for traumatizing our communities. We can’t let Congress sneak
this past us while our communities bear the cost.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38186?source=email-20260507&t=1020&akid=10698%2E5885482%2E5Vh2ej ]Click here to send your message and demand Congress pull the plug on
Trump’s ballroom and block more money for ICE’s abuses.

We need to flood Congressional inboxes NOW because when we make enough
noise, they have to listen.

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

This Women's Health Month, we wanted to tell just some of the ways she's going to champion women's health in Congress:

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130915501/619354132/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Zjk5ODJkOS0xODRhLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=46t4mNkSQ-nHOu-BULv2_DbgoP6oRlMbSZdlhQxyS60=)

Peter, this Women's Health Month, we wanted to tell just _some_ of the ways Christina is going to champion women's health in Congress:

✅ Women make up the majority of Medicaid beneficiaries. **Christina will immediately get to work to reverse the Medicaid cuts** that will kick more than 100,000 Iowans off their health care and close rural hospitals and nursing homes.

✅ Women in Iowa face significant gaps in mental healthcare, driven by a shortage of providers, rural isolation, and high costs across the board. **Christina will fight to invest in more mental healthcare for IA-01's communities.**

✅ One-third of Iowa counties are considered maternity care deserts; **Christina will work to fix this problem by supporting programs to recruit and retain more doctors and nurses in Iowa, especially in rural areas,** by boosting training programs and incentivizing health care providers to work in rural communities.

✅ Iowa bans abortion at six weeks, before most women even know they are pregnant. This abortion ban has put women's lives, health, and fertility at risk across our state. **On day one, Christina will work to put _Roe v. Wade_ back into federal law where it belongs and restore reproductive freedom for all Iowans.**

And that's not even the full list, Peter. **[Christina is running to fix Iowa's broken healthcare system and make everyone's lives better. Will you support her work? Christina will fight to invest in more mental healthcare for IA-01's communities. ✅ One-third of Iowa counties are considered maternity care deserts; Christina will work to fix this problem by supporting programs to recruit and retain more doctors and nurses in Iowa, especially in rural areas, by boosting training programs and incentivizing health care providers to work in rural communities. ✅ Iowa bans abortion at six weeks, before most women even know they are pregnant. This abortion ban has put women's lives, health, and fertility at risk across our state. On day one, Christina will work to put Roe v. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | - 19 Things to Cut When Money Gets Tight (Most People Ignore #11) | Your money is getting tight and prices are going up, which can make figuring out what to cut back on feel completely overwhelming. name: KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION
subject: It’s Time to Pay Property Taxes, How Are YOU Feeling About It?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
If you've ever looked at your ever-increasing property tax bill and wondered....

| | | | | |
---
| |

Dear Peter,Property tax bills are due this month. And for a lot of families across Johnson County, that reality is hitting hard.If you escrow your taxes, your monthly payment is about to go up.
If you are like me, you write that check and feel it. Either way, the impact is real.And the question is simple:**Why does it keep going up?** The facts are there.The county budget has increased nearly **50% over the past five years**.
Spending continues to grow.
The government is taking advantage of rising property values, even though this is an **unrealized gain** for homeowners.You are not making more money just because your home value went up.
But you are paying more taxes because of it. And it does not stop with homeowners.When property taxes go up, **rent goes up too**.
That means this is hitting families across Johnson County, whether they own or rent.This is not sustainable.It is the result of a pattern of spending without discipline and a system that keeps asking taxpayers to cover the difference.I am running for Johnson County Commission Chair because I believe it is time to change that.We need leadership that understands what it means to live within a budget.
Leadership that respects the taxpayer.
Leadership that is willing to make hard decisions instead of passing the cost along.But to make that happen, we have to win.And that takes resources.
---
|
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/hAJR7upWJ7Y?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494)
---
| |

We promise that every single dollar raised goes to good use. I have a strong track record of excellent fiscal management. Your contribution of $25, $50, $100 or more, your support helps us reach voters and build the momentum needed to bring accountability back to Johnson County.If your property tax bill made you stop and think, you are not alone.Now is the time to do something about it.With determination,
**Karen Crnkovich
** Candidate for Johnson County Commission Chair

| | Dear Friend,

In the spring of 1775, a handful of farmers and tradesmen stood their ground against the greatest military power on earth.

They didn't know how the story would end.

But they knew that freedom was worth fighting for.

The "shot heard 'round the world" set in motion a chain of events that led to the greatest experiment in self-government the world has ever known.

That's why I'm excited to share something special with you.

**The White House recently asked Hillsdale College to assist the Salute to America 250 Task Force in producing a new free video series, [_The Story of America_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/1nv9TQ__rwY5RqB6M-93oxgr0mzVqlA0XCy4n9cjc9QOucIHQmDlUVh10BEfXMcyLBCsd1uca0u2HqIGeiADFOIgMC__KXW3fVbrZ7kKwQneqG2lok_6gQ0hMffg7FiA9wK2-mL77g28JDhhNwMNxWkrFpWmj1T6Ugi23uMJjy_4eVK78vQvBPlMXNhhOiZYFcmmnYa5r5ruJNd9OVsFOvEbNFykB95z9SsZSiSrbr3iSNWqCE7cKEfNYgROwKLvXgOXTn9XWY5qdcnlneMHJxb2VcGRdflgBWfsy2NLkx5ikvS4euyd4TCuN8C35ao52FmICX2m7w1Vi_GZRrZ_SXVwumOdUI26t6WWKiQ8EiLFQc-vvFpjum98o27LkWcFwzLPbbKxo31NfqWpbOK2ngSNHBrwSFYlRPxtJEf1ymDK4SlJs8rOy0AagenojbOvA6M5o_uA3oaDfH0pgQBEqh_Lw_sA0NQJiDkxA-Li5WJxzvMvUjFmNOMsk6nEaWR7L1Gc4EDSABuwXFIKGCSKNu0C4HhRc3gb9eJZpE3QtbFlBxF9KzIjg1RC2XxdP8WeBYAveWHao8rgHmfRUs_sBs5ie8z2-XIT4ZxPwoHPlOaLW1TPKr_X5vQtg3oGnGWkhEW8aHDR6ix6wA59mNu11SoJvaG5gd9x66t4CQTGmNa6BT70e3ksRPYhRFMqCq6VCnTvxAXZPoL7xIZZ5vEWvMnWXRbs/72UiMLRtbcsq5XIZ5KkyMXNenLAEQ8EP/20)** --a sweeping, episode-by-episode journey through our nation's founding in honor of its 250th anniversary.

As we approach the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, this series invites you to learn about the principles, courage, sacrifice, and faith that made America possible--and _why this story still matters today_.

Filmed in the historic Indian Treaty Room in the Eisenhower Executive Office Building in Washington, D.C., each episode brings a pivotal chapter of the American story to life.

**Here 's a glimpse of what you can access on your journey at no cost:****
**

* **The Declaration of Independence** -- _Larry P. Arnn, President, Hillsdale College_
How the Declaration of Independence defines who we are--and what it still asks of us

* **The Formation of the Army** -- _Pete Hegseth, Secretary of War_
The moment citizen-patriots took up arms and answered liberty's call against overwhelming odds

* **The King 's Call to Arms** -- _U.S. Senator Mike Lee_
When imperial authority collided with colonial defiance--and compromise was no longer possible

* **The Culper Spy Ring** -- _Brian Kilmeade, Co-Author, George Washington 's Secret Six_
The remarkable story of ordinary Americans who risked everything to outsmart the British and save the Revolution

* **Story of the American Soldier** -- _Michael Knowles, Author and Podcaster_
A tribute to the forgotten men whose sacrifice secured American independence

* **The U.S. Marine Corps Birthday** -- _Vice President J.D. Vance_
The enduring legacy of courage, service, and sacrifice that defines the U.S. Marine Corps

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link: **

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/story-of-america-free-access](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/E8kzUGWonAtVF962Xz2inEPMOP0U1nzry-Mn80A3IyQZ75Fbrw_l3LGCZFgGihIWE6y2hRnjGh9SFK1XqWRyB-fgpiTn1CPdMStdnjuwxMvuqx58_euGGgdfPnOrmxQ8i3SRLuUTz0-VkzkleFDv2JB2zG0xZcqY_D_QoYyrde4O7ek6RO35C1sX2TtIAE5FBwKZTea3a_Rm-bN9yCaZ2ID4m5vfnKP2_fyLsugsPca1gMKjfVO1vCCWGsc1XL0IGR5K3M1dL_9H4moMm6RLF3C-MAWJoCYClWWeEHKNJa5ZVsZ9jH7ZDfjqv9kJDCyHrM_9-l0qVSyUtZwjueJowFbCGQcic-nQNELwJBr2SK-TY9fI51I38zF2oaiX3gAypBaTkhZNSZQ6vjO4WixyU_WQn3POgDe5o-XM50J7IG1TJ3BQoucmm7H0C3dVjibfadQbPqfguZaaPGDCvlBwp0EKQXjUfMI_9pQRmVUeQZNSphsexRqpSkGt-FJfyrc0dHpM7FHZ06FoYnVMv5NU6EAgsS6HhdnffrrNSL13oNAvTWFzq0yMHcx8mSSHDRyniuVWoVRI9E54KCtN_48fu1inhyPL0EqNhNTdwJtwzmV0EXSkT4oNSaug7preQDT0VLNv-F91xvsSZJ7vG1koiPcLUs9ZyFPVi6WGZtvV35IdC1xDTyJUf0Dlly9kownm-JoGs16WJNOm0NuPVZm4MMe82CC5/jQSR4l17dAwyWiT5lqxZ7EJ0Os-qhhng/20)**

**As we approach our nation 's 250th anniversary, now is the time to rediscover the spirit of 1776.**

And it's my hope that, by remembering the great deeds of the past, we can inspire Americans today to equally great deeds.

Enjoy your free video series!

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

This week, the Feucht house had a _late_ night. My daughter's dog, Bear, escaped and was gone for over six hours — his career-longest disappearing act. With all the coyotes in our neighborhood, we were beside ourselves. We searched everywhere and came up empty. Hour after hour ticked by, and the worry in our home grew heavier. Then, just after 10:00 p.m., _we found him_. The relief, the joy, the buzzing excitement that swept through our family — I can't even describe it. The prodigal dog had come home. And in that moment, a thought hit me hard: if we feel this much about a dog, _how much more_ does God feel when His sons and daughters come home. All of heaven throws a party — every altar call, every baptism, every soul that runs into the arms of Jesus.

If you're the prodigal son or daughter today, hear me — come home. There is a party waiting for you. The Son of Man did not come to condemn the world, but to save it. The Father is already running down the road toward you. I believe with everything in me that we are going to see an increase of salvation this year, all across America. Prodigal sons and daughters are turning around. They are coming home. And heaven is ready to celebrate.

clean_body: | | | | | This week, the Feucht house had a late night. My daughter's dog, Bear, escaped and was gone for over six hours — his career-longest disappearing act. With all the coyotes in our neighborhood, we were beside ourselves. We searched everywhere and came up empty. Hour after hour ticked by, and the worry in our home grew heavier. Then, just after 10:00 p.m., we found him. The relief, the joy, the buzzing excitement that swept through our family — I can't even describe it. The prodigal dog had come home. And in that moment, a thought hit me hard: if we feel this much about a dog, how much more does God feel when His sons and daughters come home. All of heaven throws a party — every altar call, every baptism, every soul that runs into the arms of Jesus. If you're the prodigal son or daughter today, hear me — come home. There is a party waiting for you. The Son of Man did not come to condemn the world, but to save it. The Father is already running down the road toward you. I believe with everything in me that we are going to see an increase of salvation this year, all across America. Prodigal sons and daughters are turning around. They are coming home. And heaven is ready to celebrate. | Till All Hear, Sean Feucht P.S. Big Tech continues to mark our emails and text messages as spam or junk. The enemy wants us silenced, but we refuse to comply! Peter, [**Because of the Supreme Court’s ruling to overturn the Voting Rights Act, Alabama will once again be ground zero in the fight for voting rights. That’s why I’m running for Governor. If that’s all you need to know, please make a split donation between me and Blue Amp Action here. If not, keep reading.**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11158?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.07_Jones-Disgraceful_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=4&akid=2197%2E259176%2E_ublYb) I’m disappointed and angry—but not surprised—by the Supreme Court’s recent decision. [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11158?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.07_Jones-Disgraceful_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=5&akid=2197%2E259176%2E_ublYb) Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act protected Black representation in the South for decades. It was a pillar of our country’s march toward progress, and our democracy. It’s why we saw the late Rep. John Lewis and other Civil Rights heroes get beaten on the Edmund Pettis bridge in Selma. It was the product of generations of freedom fighters. Justice Kagan said it better than I can: _“The Voting Rights Act is—or, now more accurately, was—‘one of the most consequential, efficacious, and amply justified exercises of federal legislative power in our Nation’s history,’”_ _“It was born of the literal blood of Union soldiers and civil rights marchers. It ushered in awe-inspiring change, bringing this Nation closer to fulfilling the ideals of democracy and racial equality. And it has been repeatedly, and overwhelmingly, reauthorized by the people’s representatives in Congress. Only they have the right to say it is no longer needed—not the Members of this Court.”_ Now, state governments will become even more critical in the fight to protect our right to vote. Here’s what I mean. If there’s not a break of one-party rule in Montgomery, this could be Alabama’s new Congressional map. [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11158?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.07_Jones-Disgraceful_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=6&akid=2197%2E259176%2E_ublYb) Currently, there are almost no checks in our state government to prevent this from happening. **If you don’t know where folks live in Alabama I can tell you that a map like this will result in no minority representation in Congress. I'm running for Governor to change that.** Folks, it’s up to us to continue the fight for equality, no matter what this court throws at us. **_And my opponent, Tommy Tuberville, is on record supporting all of this._** He said that the GOP should try to make 15 new seats across the South in response to this ruling. It’s on us to change course. Alabama has been ground zero for the fight for voting rights, and we need to lead again. [**That’s why I’m humbly asking, will you chip in any amount to make as split donation between me and Blue Amp Action?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11158?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.07_Jones-Disgraceful_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=7&akid=2197%2E259176%2E_ublYb) | | [CHIP IN](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11158?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.07_Jones-Disgraceful_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=8&akid=2197%2E259176%2E_ublYb)

subject: This should not be legal

body:
This is an attack ad by a Trump-backed Super PAC called MAGA Kentucky
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2205%2E791427%2ETcrNOX)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_ai_ads_pet_may26/?refcode=em260507-1-180&akid=2205%2E791427%2ETcrNOX)
Friend, what you’re looking at here is a screenshot from an attack ad by a Trump-backed Super PAC called MAGA Kentucky.
The ad depicts Ilhan, AOC, and Thomas Massie having dinner, holding hands, and checking into a hotel room together. **It’s entirely AI-generated.**
To say this is despicable is an understatement. Campaign attack ads are generally misleading, but AI-generated ads like this cross a line and should never have been allowed in the first place. This ad even goes so far as to use AI to sexualize two women members of Congress. It’s disgusting, and the ad should be taken down immediately.
And furthermore, **AI-generated ads like this should not be legal.**
This is a common sense idea: If you want to run an attack ad, use real footage and focus on real things. Don’t mislead, confuse, and lie to voters who may not understand what they’re looking at, especially as this technology gets more advanced.
If we can’t crack down on this, we will be looking at a future where attack ads are more deceitful, unhinged, and nasty than ever before. A future where nobody knows what to believe anymore. A future where AI is used to incite more hate, division, and violence at a time when the temperature desperately needs to come down.
[**If you agree that it’s time to put guardrails on the use of AI, sign on to Ilhan Omar’s petition calling for a ban on AI-generated political ads. This unethical practice is growing quickly, which means we need to take action now before things spiral further out of hand.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_ai_ads_pet_may26/?source=em260507-1-180&refcode2=2205.791427.TcrNOX&akid=2205%2E791427%2ETcrNOX)

Team Ilhan

# Why Conservative Oklahoma Needs Todd Russ Back as Treasurer
---
|
---
| | Dear Conservative Friend,
As a lifelong Oklahoman and proud conservative, Treasurer Todd Russ has delivered real results for our state without raising taxes. Since taking office in 2023, he has generated the highest portfolio earnings in state history and exceeded investment goals by $122 million over three years.
That is conservative stewardship at its best, protecting your tax dollars and growing Oklahoma’s reserves while every other state struggles with big-spending politicians.

Today is the National Day of Prayer -- a reminder that faith, freedom, and fellowship still matter in America.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..BewsrbSAlkTOE8xp5OMv1wl5uPAmhUcZQ4JXtaD67YI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=196781012)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=196781012&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk2NzgxMDEyLCJpYXQiOjE3NzgxNjYzNTAsImV4cCI6MTc4MDc1ODM1MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.haT32BGeL2SoE1eeVRR-CaSgmP6GC2B1fK61sOszF2A)
It is also a reminder of the proper order of the American way of life:
**Faith. Family. Country.**
This year's theme is: GLORIFY GOD AMONG THE NATIONS - SEEKING HIM IN ALL GENERATIONS
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b3d97006-2031-4f49-a6b7-253ab3767b3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The tradition of national prayer in America dates back to the founding of our Republic. During the Revolutionary War, the Continental Congress called for days of prayer, fasting, and thanksgiving. George Washington himself recognized the importance of prayer and public faith in the life of the nation.
But Washington did more than speak of tolerance. He helped define America's higher standard: true religious freedom. In his famous 1790 letter to the Hebrew Congregation of Newport, Rhode Island, he wrote that the United States "gives to bigotry no sanction, to persecution no assistance."
_**That promise still matters.**_
My family and I recently returned from Israel Advocacy meetings in Washington, D.C. It was a blessing to participate as a family, alongside a Connecticut coalition. Our Connecticut Pastors were members of the **National Hispanic Christian Leadership Conference (NHCLC)** that has connected and equipped Hispanic Christian leaders, pastors, and communities across the United States and around the world--strengthening the Church and advancing biblical values in society. Becky Hernandez, the Executive Director of the NHCLC was part of our group. The outreach of this organization is powerful and my family and I have been engaging with these pastors over the past year.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d90d5b7b-7683-4a07-9ff6-85d8c1e3418d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I came because my son, Jonathan, has spent the last three years working to build common ground between Christians and Jews -- common ground that should be natural, but has not always been.
To witness pastors and rabbis standing together and reminding elected officials that antisemitism will not be tolerated -- and that Jews in America are not alone because Christians stand beside them -- was deeply meaningful.
The churches that may have been silent during the Holocaust are not silent in America today.
This effort was organized by [Eagles' Wings](https://substack.com/redirect/9608f3b9-411e-447c-b035-827ede591ba6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Bishop Robert Stearns, whom we have known for several years.
Israel Advocacy Day is built on a simple conviction: _**faith leaders cannot remain on the sidelines**_. Rabbis and pastors must step into the rooms where decisions are made and speak with one voice for Israel, against antisemitism, and for the safety and dignity of Jewish communities here and abroad.
In the wake of October 7th -- a day that will live in infamy -- Bishop Stearns has often asked a simple but piercing question:
**" Where are you, Church?"**
Historically, the relationship between Christians and Jews has not always been easy. There were times when Jews stood alone in the face of persecution, including during the Holocaust, when too many institutions and nations remained silent. That is why gatherings like this matter. They show that many churches in America today refuse to repeat the mistakes of silence and indifference.
_**This was one of the most memorable trips I have taken to Washington because it demonstrated true camaraderie: pastors and rabbis, Republicans and Democrats, gathered together without hostility toward one another. It felt reminiscent of a different era in American politics -- one where common ground could still be found.**_
We had disagreements. But they were civil. The debate was healthy. Sometimes the issue is perspective, and sometimes the solution is awareness and education.
During our visit, our group met with staff representatives from the offices of Congressman John Larson, Congresswoman Rosa DeLauro, and Senator Chris Murphy. Part of our delegation separately met with a staff representative from the office of Congressman Jim Himes.
Separately, my son and I met with staff representatives from the office of Congressman Rich McCormick on healthcare-related matters. Being on the Hill, my son also ran into a friend working as a staffer for Congressman Pete Sessions. Those meetings were noticeably warmer and demonstrated the importance of continued bipartisan engagement on issues of faith, Israel, and combating antisemitism.
_**There was polarization in some of the offices we visited. The reception varied from office to office.**_
_**But that did not faze the delegation - it strengthened the resolve.**_
Our message was simple: hate has no place in worship, antisemitism must not be tolerated, and Americans must be free to pray and live their faith without fear.
Our group stood firmly for Israel's right to defend itself, regardless of whether certain members of Congress dislike the personal leadership of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. That distinction matters. _**Disagreements over politics should never become an excuse to weaken Israel 's ability to protect its people. As I stated it was like giving Israel a bulletproof vest to defend itself but no weapons to attack the aggressor.**_
We also addressed antisemitism on both the left and the right sides of the political aisle. Hatred of Jews is unacceptable regardless of political affiliation. Silence in the face of antisemitism only allows it to grow.
With the constant attacks on synagogues and Jewish communities in New York City, Michigan, and elsewhere, Jews should be able to pray, gather, and attend events without fear.
My rabbi from Temple Sholom, Mitch Hurvitz, spoke about millions of dollars in security upgrades for a synagogue, including ballistic glass -- things no one would imagine needing in the United States of America - and certainly not the peaceful town of Greenwich Connecticut. Rabbi Mitch also addressed the non-profit security grants that are for physical upgrades but not ongoing personnel.
_**But this is where we are in a post-October 7th world.**_
_**And we should not accept it as normal.**_
What stood out most to me was that this trip reflected the three pillars of the American way of life -- in the right order:
**Faith. Family. Country.**
Faith gives us our moral compass.
Family gives us purpose and responsibility.
Country gives us the freedom to live those values openly.
That is why it is so important to fight for all three.

CNN: Efforts to game the 2026 election intensify as Republicans draw new maps [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=050726_1&amount=25]
The immediate impact shows how partisan the Louisiana v. Callais case before the Supreme Court was, Team.
In the week since this decision, five states have already moved to redraw their maps , dilute the impact of minority voters, and return parts of the country to a suppressive era we thought we left behind sixty years ago. Louisiana itself stopped an election with voting already in progress , and other states are moving to change their own maps soon.
CNN says this has created " an unprecedented amount of flux in American democracy six months before Election Day ." Candidates don’t know where to run. Lawmakers are seeing their districts carved up. Voters don’t know which district they live in.
This is all about power. Whether districts are fair or everyone is represented has been tossed by the wayside for MAGA's desperate grasp to control a country that's more disillusioned with their actions by the day.

Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process , is going to take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters.
Long before the MAGA movement, Chief Justice Roberts saw the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. President Trump followed this decision with a directive for conservative-led states to erase multiple majority-Black districts across the South. His supporters are climbing over one another to comply.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.

|
Peter,
Yesterday, Chief Justice John Roberts stood before a judicial conference and insisted the Supreme Court is not partisan. That its justices are not "political actors."
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ESjUKGbSL-l6tbE2d93WCCTbZN7gd4DuZyKhV-FWhuC1M4k2CEHEg2mX0bsCs9aXTs4D4oaT7QV3jshg3nmKYLcBNtiPwBYf19fFai5N2PBwj_1bHie8mpHerJqJmt0T-T-TEoEjCSqRw3L7_j172x8fgtBOLs429xWwC9p8JDrTW4MRBmeGe_ORuJkcaHoIn3p3PYhZqGimcA-Bul247LhJwaH-1RPo5zddkRJBE2c=&c=i6jlWbZhoI55eb8GajR5A0eJervkR_gMDf3F-7QZK9oXYSCs-6lf6A==&ch=jrSDjwxthgSsenFKzmsu_KOSVOPItPoiZUyG63AHihkqKj4lupZJ9Q==)
---
You're not fooling anyone with that B.S., John.
This is the court that lied to the American public during confirmation hearings--conservative justice after justice calling Roe v. Wade "settled law" before gutting it. The court that shredded 60 years of legal precedent. Gutted the Voting Rights Act. Kneecapped the Clean Air and Clean Water Acts. Handed billionaires unlimited political influence through Citizens United. And granted Donald Trump presidential immunity to shield him from criminal prosecution.
Every conservative justice made their rise with the backing of shadowy billionaires, right-wing think tanks, and political operatives. Some have accepted lavish gifts--all-expense paid vacations, shady real estate deals--from conservative power brokers, then refused to recuse themselves from cases where obvious conflicts of interest existed. Roberts' own wife has reportedly made over $10 million as a legal consultant for law firms with business before the court.
Roberts is in damage control because the American people can see what this court is: corrupt, captured, and wholly beholden to Donald Trump and MAGA billionaires.
[The calls for reform are growing louder. And Defend Our Courts intends to help lead the charge.
