Since we started this work, we've won some tremendous victories that show anything is possible when people refuse to give up.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260507-1-expansion&t=1&akid=11456%2E3935704%2EL022VD)_Visit to Newtown, CT._
---
Friends -
Since we started this work, we've won some tremendous victories that show anything is possible when people refuse to give up.
We've also experienced hard and often tragic setbacks that require us to summon the courage to continue fighting the next day.
I know these feelings well.
Right now, we're in the middle of those difficult times.
When this happens, it's important to think about why we set out to accomplish any goal.
And while a lot of people are familiar with my story, the truth is that it wasn't my shooting that inspired my decision to take on the challenge of making our communities safer from gun violence. Newtown was actually the moment I knew we had to do something.
I remember driving from New York to Newtown to meet with some of the parents and members of the community who lost so much that day.
We talked to the families, I walked over to an empty chair, and I said "Enough."
Our work is just as important today as it was then -- even when it looks like progress is impossible.
But I cannot do it alone. I need people who are willing to be with me not just when the issue of gun violence is in the news, but also when there seems to be so much more going on.
Because the truth is, every day families are experiencing loss because of the epidemic of gun violence. Lives are upended because of tragic loss, violent crime, threats with guns, and more.
So I am asking for your help, because I cannot do this alone:
[**Please contribute $5, $50, or whatever it is that feels right toward our work to make communities across the country safer from gun violence. It will add up when we all chip in what we can. Every little bit helps. I know that very well.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260507-1-expansion&t=2&akid=11456%2E3935704%2EL022VD)

| | | |
Peter,
All hell is breaking loose in Louisiana. Last week, the Supreme Court ruled to gut the foundations of the legislation that ended Jim Crow, the Voting Rights Act.
In response, Louisiana's Republican governor Jeff Landry declared a "state of emergency" so that he can cancel my election (where voting had already begun!), erase our majority black district, and silence the voters who sent me to Congress.
But we aren't going down without a fight:
---
| | [](https://6oz8v8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RS8QxhfPpUoG1LpiNbd2aVxmqGmgbytOmIIrx7Haqn5I1y21vAniFyvxlxyUECYYxoc68ijUeVG_XJ9lX9UFepuJ9sMPXAafvgax8XkJchYhusPJckJYIP5eLzjTmeyvEKTyqtjETa5VnhRdCJHNoUCfuufRIXvcimlWy9jrziZXPZtzQNT-H_3EjU7UQfu7Mf3SQP6ddZEgvY9kS74xVpc5vjMwLTEA&c=bFr8p22NsR7gBEwrXTJHJD9sEmn28ueYJHftLa_JXTPZjtEq6e6KAQ==&ch=Eu05x2nBdtlW27AMPun904fdcFwnm1NufeU6yU0UXx_47dboTU8EyQ==)
---
They are erasing our district because black voters pose an existential threat to MAGA.
Earlier this spring black voters propelled a Democrat to a landslide win in a Trump +13 Louisiana state house special election. They see that we are organizing and winning in MAGA's backyard and they cannot let it stand.
They plan to splinter our voters into far flung red districts across the state. They want black voters atomized, disjointed, and disorganized so that we no longer hold power as a voting bloc that can threaten their grasp on power. They hope to turn back the clock on African-American political progress.
They will not succeed. I have fought this fight before and I will fight it again. The torch that the Civil Rights Movement passed to us is still burning and I refuse to let it go out.
We are prepared for every possible contingency. We have entered into a historic lawsuit against our MAGA governor to stop the unprecedented suspension of our election. And if their effort to move me into a redder district succeeds we are rapidly scaling our campaign so we can compete and win against all odds.
As a black Democrat from the Deep South I know how to win tough battles but it's safe to say I am now in the fight of my life. clean_body: Our Republican governor has declared a “state of emergency” so that he can cancel my election where voting had already begun, erase our majority black district, and silence the voters who sent me to C | | | | | == | | | | Peter, All hell is breaking loose in Louisiana. Last week, the Supreme Court ruled to gut the foundations of the legislation that ended Jim Crow, the Voting Rights Act. In response, Louisiana's Republican governor Jeff Landry declared a "state of emergency" so that he can cancel my election (where voting had already begun!), erase our majority black district, and silence the voters who sent me to Congress. But we aren't going down without a fight: | | == They are erasing our district because black voters pose an existential threat to MAGA. Earlier this spring black voters propelled a Democrat to a landslide win in a Trump +13 Louisiana state house special election. They see that we are organizing and winning in MAGA's backyard and they cannot let it stand. They plan to splinter our voters into far flung red districts across the state. They want black voters atomized, disjointed, and disorganized so that we no longer hold power as a voting bloc that can threaten their grasp on power. They hope to turn back the clock on African-American political progress. They will not succeed. I have fought this fight before and I will fight it again. The torch that the Civil Rights Movement passed to us is still burning and I refuse to let it go out. We are prepared for every possible contingency. We have entered into a historic lawsuit against our MAGA governor to stop the unprecedented suspension of our election. And if their effort to move me into a redder district succeeds we are rapidly scaling our campaign so we can compete and win against all odds. I've seen McDonald's Managers more qualified to run for Senate than you.

So, on behalf of all real MAGA Patriots, please check yourself.

No amount of RINO Establishment support can help you. If you get to D.C., you'll be eaten alive by the Radical Left and MAGA. You may think you have opinions now, but you'll cave into whichever lobbyist donates the most money to your RINO PAC. You're no better than any other Corrupt RINO who attacks President Trump.

I’m a proud Ohioan, born and raised in Youngstown. I grew up under tough circumstances, often going to bed hungry or without a stable roof over my head.

Neighbors, community, and public schools helped save my life.

**I’ve spent my life focused on giving back and building a state where everyone has a chance — and no one is left behind. That’s exactly what this campaign has been about.**

In the past year, we’ve built an incredible, unprecedented movement. So many Ohioans have come together to fight for a stronger, fairer future.

_Now we have the chance to make that a reality. The chance to finally flip our state blue and give Ohioans the committed leadership we deserve._

**This will be one of the closest and most expensive races in the entire country. Cybersecurity upgrades. Physical security testing. Backup plans for ballot distribution in case they come for the mail. Audits, drills, scenarios. I’m doing this for nearly half a million voters who are counting on me to get it right. **The people attacking our elections aren't slowing down. Neither am I.** I love this work. Protecting voters, securing elections, fighting back when someone tries to undermine them. **This is what I was built for.** I’ll use the expertise I’ve developed as an attorney, an elections official, and the executive of a large organization to do just that for every voter in Colorado. There is a quiet argument going on right now in coffee shops and county supervisor meetings across Mississippi. Some of my fellow conservatives have started treating data centers as the next big threat to Mississippi communities, convinced they are going to drain our aquifer, strain our power grid, raise electric bills, and leave behind nothing but fenced off buildings humming with servers. I understand the suspicion. I share some of it. But I think we are about to talk ourselves into a serious mistake, and I want to make the case for why we should not.
Start with the size of what is happening. The Electric Power Research Institute projects that data centers will consume between 4.6% and 9.1% of all electricity generated in the United States by 2030 -- more than double their share in 2023. Goldman Sachs forecasts a 165% increase in global data-center power demand by the end of the decade. Whether you love artificial intelligence or roll your eyes at it, the build-out is real, and the money behind it is enormous. The only question is which states get the investment and which states watch it go to Texas, Georgia, and Virginia.
Mississippi has spent most of my lifetime watching tech investment go somewhere else. Now it isn't. Amazon Web Services has committed $25 billion across multiple Mississippi sites. Compass Datacenters is building a $10 billion campus near Meridian. xAI announced a $20 billion campus in Southaven, the largest single private investment in the state's history. Add the smaller projects and Mississippi has roughly $49 billion in headline data-center investment on the books. That is not a typo. By any measure, it is the largest wave of private industrial investment Mississippi has ever seen.
What does that buy us? Construction crews working five-to-eight-year build-outs. Permanent operating jobs that pay at least 125% of the average state wage. Substations, fiber, water and sewer lines that serve the data center but stay in the ground for the next industrial user too. And importantly, it creates enough new electricity demand to potentially improve the economics of the grid for everyone else -- if we make sure data centers actually pay the infrastructure costs they create. That "if" matters, and I'll come back to it in Part 2.
Conservatives ought to be careful about reflexively saying no to this. One of the oldest truths in economics and politics is simple: if you don't build, somebody else builds, and you live in their world. The country that hosts the compute capacity for AI will set the standards for everything that runs on it -- banking, defense, medicine, agriculture. We have spent four years arguing about TikTok and Chinese surveillance. The same logic that makes us nervous about Beijing controlling the apps on our kids' phones makes me nervous about Beijing controlling the data centers that run the next generation of those apps. American compute belongs in America.
It is also worth being honest about who is doing the work during the build. A hyperscale data-center campus is not a quick six-month industrial park job. The Compass campus near Meridian is planned to be built out over eight years; AWS's Madison County complex is on a multi-year construction schedule. That is electricians, pipefitters, concrete crews, ironworkers, truck drivers, and surveyors, putting steel in the ground year after year. We can debate how many permanent jobs ultimately stay local. What is not debatable is that the construction work is real, long-term, and already underway.
There is another argument I hear from neighbors that I take seriously, which is that the projects are being shoved down our throats with no public input. On that, the critics have a real point, but that is a different problem from the projects themselves. We can have public hearings, environmental review, and ratepayer protections without throwing away the investment. The fight over xAI's gas turbines in Southaven is genuinely complicated, and the legal justification Mississippi DEQ used for its "temporary-mobile" interpretation is now being challenged in federal court. That is the regulatory process working the way it is supposed to work, even if imperfectly and slowly. It is not a reason to send the next $20 billion project to Tulsa instead.
And finally -- this is the part the loudest skeptics tend to skip -- the alternative is not a Mississippi where nothing changes. The alternative is a Mississippi where we keep watching our young people leave for Atlanta and Nashville, where we keep waiting for the next big employer to magically arrive, and where the AI economy gets built somewhere else by people who will charge us to use it. We have a real seat at this table for the first time in a generation. I would like to keep it.
In Part 2, I want to talk about the environmental concerns honestly, because some of them are right. In Part 3, I want to talk about how Mississippi is paying for these projects, and why a true conservative ought to be deeply skeptical of the deals our state is signing. Welcoming the boom and demanding it be done right are not contradictions. They are the same job.

# Meet Dan Cox and Rob Krop TOMORROW - and pick up your signs and campaign materials
---
|
---
|
---
| Fellow Marylander,
We have just five (5) days until ballots begin to be mailed out to voters. We need your urgent support today to reach every voter with the consistent conservative message of our Republican values.

As a lifelong Republican who is the only Republican in the race ever elected to public office while also being a 30-year small business owner, demonstrating a voting record you can trust, I know how to work across the aisle and have done so to advance lower taxes, increased parental rights and civil liberties, and to defend our constitution.

And I have the experience and opportunity to win this fall and put Maryland back on track with common sense and affordability for all.

Come on out and meet me and my running mate Rob Krop at the Kent Island American Legion, 800 Romancoke Road, Stevensville, MD, tomorrow from 6pm-8pm and pick up your yard signs and campaign materials!

This race is important and we must win. If you can chip in to help with any amount, thank you.

See you tomorrow!

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

[_**So I’m asking you to get in the game with me: Will you click here and chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to help us launch this re-election campaign with serious people-powered momentum?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130937922/619415916/-1329041611?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDZlNWZkNC0yZDRhLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Swx2dp8wKTV-uVbHBpPfvWT27wWfruQeYXLiLWvT_U=) This campaign is about lower costs, affordable housing, healthcare, childcare, working people, our rights, and our democracy. # Across the Commonwealth
---
|
---
**2026 LEGISLATIVE TOWN HALL** Yesterday evening, Del. Rasoul hosted a legislative town hall at Fishwick Middle School. As always, our community had insightful questions and a great curiosity for all we do in the General Assembly. This year, we also took time to recognize our educators with some teacher appreciation prizes!
---

clean_body: | | | Across the Commonwealth | 2026 LEGISLATIVE TOWN HALL Yesterday evening, Del. Rasoul hosted a legislative town hall at Fishwick Middle School. As always, our community had insightful questions and a great curiosity for all we do in the General Assembly. This year, we also took time to recognize our educators with some teacher appreciation prizes! | ~~ | ~ NEW BIOTECHNOLOGY INCUBATOR SITE OPEN IN ROANOKE New medical research is coming to Roanoke! Yesterday, ROVA Labs opened at Carilion Clinic. This biotechnology incubator site will bring new jobs and scientific discoveries to our region. It is a cross sector partnership that is expected to bring 250 jobs to Roanoke! | In the Community | | ROANOKE PLAWKERS MAY SCHEDULE Join the Roanoke Plawkers throughout the month to clean up our neighborhoods while spending time with community members! Plawking: picking up litter while walking. It's good exercise, it's good for the environment, and it's good for bringing neighbors and community partners together to meet, interact, and explore Roanoke neighborhoods by foot! | LEGISLATIVE WRAP UP WITH ROANOKE CHAMBER Our business community is pivotal to the success of our localities. Regional legislators came together this week to update and answer questions about our legislative session with the Roanoke Regional Chamber of Commerce. When we work together, we can make Virginia the best place for business. | DINOSAUR STEAM EXPERIENCE\- May 8 Join Kids Square tomorrow for a fun and educational dinosaur STEAM experience! This experience is free with admission. | SALEM AFTER 5 - May 8 Join the City of Salem for an evening of live music, great food, and community fun at Salem after 5! Bring a chair or blanket and relax while enjoying local food vendors, and activities for all ages. ~~ | DAISY ART PARADE - May 9 Save the date! The Daisy Art Parade & Carnival is returning this Saturday, May 9th. The carnival is 10 am - 5 pm and the parade is at noon! The entire event is at Rivers Edge Park North (302 Wiley Drive SW, Roanoke, VA 24014). | SUNDAE ON SUNDAY FUNDRAISER - May17 Enjoy a Sundae Sweet Treat while watching the antics of Joe Lee who is an artist and cartoonist. He will be performing with his flea circus to bring some fun clown entertainment. Help Roanoke City Democrats raise some funds and enjoy local fun entertainment and a sweet treat! ~ | | | WALK & ROLL TO SCHOOL DAY Yesterday was RCPS walk and roll to school day! Thank you to the many school PTAs who coordinated routes and everyone who worked together to help our students walk or bike to school safely. | WILLIAM FLEMING PLANT SALE Support the William Fleming Greenhouse Club at this year's Spring Plant Sale! Stop by the WFHS Greenhouse Friday and Saturday to pick up garden vegetables, herbs, and perennials at great prices (cash only) while supporting the Colonels. Friday: 4-7 pm Saturday: 9 am-1 pm Prices: 1 for $3 or 2 for $5 | Community Resources | COMMUNITY OFFICE HOURS VIRTUAL OFFICE HOURS WITH DEL. RASOUL'S TEAM Our office is now holding virtual office hours to meet with constituents. Meet with a member of Delegate Sam Rasoul's team to ask questions, share concerns, or get help with state-related issues. We're here to listen and assist however we can. ~~ | | KNOW YOUR RIGHTS WITH ICE There have been recent reports of ICE throughout the state. The ACLU has created a collection of resources in the case you or someone you know interacts with ICE agents. Read and share the resources found ~~. ~~ | CONTACT YOUR FEDERAL REPRESENTATIVE In many ways, it feels like our federal government is under attack by the current administration. While our office is happy to assist however we can, it is still crucial that you engage our federal representatives. Find the contact information for the Virginia Congressional Delegation ~~. ~~ | JOIN THE ROANOKE CITY DEMOCRATS! RCDC's monthly business meeting is the third Thursday each month. Watch their Facebook for an upcoming announcement of the agenda. The meetings are available virtually for those who write to mailto:info@roanokedemocrats.com, requesting the link. ~~ | JOIN ROANOKE YOUNG DEMS! Meetings occur on the second Monday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies. Contact: mailto:youngdemocratsroanoke@gmail.com to get involved! | BUILDING BELOVED COMMUNITIES Building Beloved Communities helps nonprofits and government agencies step into 2026 with clarity and confidence - whether it's bringing your annual report to life, guiding strategic planning, or supporting your team with resilience and leadership tools. mailto:info@buildingbelovedcommunities.com "mailto:info@buildingbelovedcommunities.com" and set your organization up for the years ahead. ~~ | Thank you for your support! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to me anytime. My very best, | Del. | | | Friend — What if a campaign didn’t start with a stack of big checks... What if it started with people? People who’ve worked double shifts.
People who’ve had to stretch a paycheck.
People who are tired of being ignored and disregarded in favor of special interests with deep pockets. _That’s our campaign._ **Elizabeth Guzman didn’t come up through corporate boardrooms or political machines.** She came up working three jobs, raising a family, and fighting her way forward — just like so many people she’s running to represent. Now she’s running for Congress to flip VA-7, in a race we can really win. But we still need your help. Hey folks,
This one went completely off the rails in the best possible way.
**Jack Cocchiarella** and I got right into it and we started where everybody's attention is right now: Trump, insider trading, the Iran war, and whether the people around him are cashing in while the rest of the country gets screwed. But then the conversation cracked open into something way bigger -- power, corruption, billionaires, the future of the Democratic Party, and whether America's entire obsession with "rugged individualism" is breaking us apart.
We got personal. We disagreed. We pushed each other hard. And honestly? These are the kinds of conversations I think we need a lot more of right now.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:37**] We dig into the DOJ probe surrounding suspicious oil trades tied to Trump's Iran escalation -- and ask who inside Trumpworld may have been cashing in.
* [**00:12:59**] The conversation shifts to billionaires, Wall Street, and why some of the most powerful people in America actually benefit from chaos and instability.
* [**00:20:07**] Jack breaks down the insane private equity takeover of youth sports -- including parents getting punished for taking photos at hockey games.
* [**00:33:00**] We debate how Democrats should actually use power if they win in 2028 -- from nuking the filibuster to taking on monopolies and corporate corruption.
* [**00:45:37**] The second half turns into a full-on philosophical fight over individualism, expertise, freedom, systems, and whether Americans are being sold a myth about success and self-reliance.

This episode covers a lot of ground, but underneath all of it is one question: what kind of country are we actually trying to build? If you're frustrated with performative politics and want deeper conversations about power, class, media, democracy, and where this movement goes next, this one is essential. And if you value conversations that are honest, messy, thoughtful, and real -- help us keep building this thing.

--Mike

SAVE THE DATE:
Movie Screening + Discussion
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Dallas%20data%20centers.jpg]
Tech giants are building data centers across Texas, and our communities are paying the price. These facilities threaten us with higher water bills, increased pollution, public health risks, and added strain on our already unstable energy grid. We need to put our communities before this corporate slop.
JOIN TOP for a FREE film screening and discussion to learn more about the impacts of data centers.
📆 Thursday, June 11th at 6 p.m.
📍 Texas Theatre in Dallas (231 Jefferson Blvd.)
🏆 Attendees have a chance to win a $100 gift card!
For more information, contact Jet at (469) 550-4750.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Eng%20-%20New%20RSVP%20here.png]
ADD YOUR NAME:
Help Defend Birthright
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Banner%20-%20Defend%20birthright%20citizenship.png]
TOP is joining our national affiliate Popular Democracy [https://populardemocracy.org/] in defending the 14th Amendment from insidious right-wing attacks. This amendment is being targeted right now by the likes of MAGA-aligned think tanks and the White House because it guarantees that everyone born or naturalized in our country is a citizen, entitled to equal protection under the law. The promise in this amendment has shaped every major civil rights victory in our nation.
Every child born here belongs, and that right comes directly from the Constitution — not the whims of any president. For generations, people in our country have fought to expand this promise. That's why Trump wants it gone.
While we await a ruling soon from the Supreme Court, we need Congress to step up and do everything within their power to ensure our basic rights are upheld. Demand your U.S. Representative defend our right to belong in this country we call home.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/5TIhxa2pd06S40RpvXMaTA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/5TIhxa2pd06S40RpvXMaTA2]

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20healthcare.jpg]
Join the team! We’re eager to bring on board talented and passionate team players who are committed to justice, protecting rights, and moving our communities forward.
If you or someone you know sounds like a good fit, we want to hear from you! Email recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] with any questions.
Come work with Team Teal, and help us build the Texas each and every one of us deserves.
Check out our job openings. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/]
TOP Tip: Chip in to free Black mamas and caregivers this Mother's Day
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20mamas.jpg]
With Mother's Day coming up, we're lifting up the vital work being done by National Bail Out [https://www.nationalbailout.org/] to support Black mamas and caregivers. When you pitch in to #FreeBlackMamas , you're doing more than breaking open cages; your gift also supports Black mamas and caregivers once they return home to their loved ones. Your generosity provides essential bail funds and critical reentry support, including childcare, legal aid, housing assistance, meals, mental health resources, and help with court-ordered fees. Learn more and contribute for Mother’s Day! [https://www.nationalbailout.org/giftguide]

When **Mai Vang** was growing up in South Sacramento, her family didn’t have the luxury of waiting for someone else to fix things.

Her grandparents fled the war in Laos and grew crops in Elk Grove to support their family when they arrived in the US with nothing. Mai had to rely on food stamps and Medicaid to get by. And she attended the same public schools in the neighborhood she lives in today.

She watched her community — Hmong refugees, immigrant families, farmers, working people — get left behind by politicians who knew nothing about what their lives actually looked like or the struggles they faced.

So she decided to run for office and be the fearless fighter her district deserves.

**I’m proud to announce that Leaders We Deserve is endorsing Mai’s run for Congress in CA-07!**

On the Sacramento City Unified School Board, she authored and passed California’s first ever Safe Haven resolution, making sure that schools remain a safe place for students and families, regardless of their immigration status. Mai also helped lead the Sacramento Alliance for Vaccine Equity during the pandemic, making sure that it was multilingual so that immigrant families who spoke dozens of varying languages across the region still had access to those vaccines.

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquO38L98SklfBdoDq94y0bmIPp1sMsxRlzUR9IaKq2v2hzRZ59G9QKzB0xkf_J-DO7YZjEzEaqoxC2CfkWkQky8ccioAqisCj9vpfhzfXONurpe-yRAREruuPTeeT9CuktFdVTN9TWlS3bMUd0SO4rRLGLa1cBHDEhz1AXyt6soStkSkIH4awnHz1evc275HS_aUAjeNBCi58XAgvWht_wkx-MfzevNiIvvzVbzXmqmzcHX8RSaAZ97GkurKkwLlC4W57pIMVC-aaDTDvnorJNWnH1y0JwdIiMwATazIFNSaRP6Dq8DwPPtoFgeH3E_XG7-gew7zxofg1K3IUrMqiKU/4qf/LY5_YnCzTaKkb4EpAHd_RA/h5/h001.XagkQVR_rJ-k8mAM1q0F1m2Hf0YIVw7QrEKRGgYwRfU)

# The Latest from the Campaign Trail
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Tessa’s Birthday Party Has Grown! Come celebrate the Hodge High Holidays With Us! Friday, May 22, at 7:00 PM
(Note the new date and time.)**
Tessa is celebrating her 38th birthday on May 20. Then on May 22 the founder of NotStepping Back, Andrew Hodge, celebrates his birthday. Right in the middle of the birthdays is May 21—the perfect day for them to marry sixteen years ago, so come wish them happy birthdays and anniversary.

The Hodge High Holidays and Silent Auction event will be held at the locally owned,**El Torito Restaurant and Meat Market** in Hesperia, California. Please join Tessa and Andrew for delicious food, fun, and fundraising during the last critical push before the primaries! Use the QR code above or [RSVP at Act Blue at this link.](https://us.list-manage.com/fLpSGkopXr6?e=db7cb92046&c2id=f83d0f9d6921da6906ad40d7e682269c) (If you have a ticket already to Tessa’s birthday, it is good for this rescheduled event.) Let’s celebrate love, birthdays, community, NotStepping Back, and the fight to flip CA-23.
Special thanks to El Torito owner Paul Paz, for supporting the campaign. If you are in the High Desert please be sure to stop by for some amazing food and to support a small local business that supports Democrats.
---
|
---
| | **Endorsement Alert****Cedric White, Lancaster City Council Member, AD 34 Delegate**
“As someone who has spent decades working with youth and families in our community, as a mentor, probation officer, educator, and community advocate, I know how important it is to have leaders who truly understand the struggles everyday people face. That’s why I’m proud to endorse Tessa Lynn Hodge for Congress. Tessa’s background as a social worker and mental health professional gives her a firsthand understanding of the challenges impacting working families, children, and underserved communities across our district. She has dedicated her career to helping people through trauma, poverty, and crisis with compassion and dignity. Like me, she believes real public safety starts with investing in people, supporting our youth, and creating opportunities for families to succeed. Tessa is bringing heart, experience, and authentic community leadership to this race, and I believe she will be a strong advocate for the High Desert and all of CA-23.”
**Melissa Ayala Quintero - School board member for Redlands Unified School District
** "As a School Board Member of Redlands Unified, it is a pleasure to endorse Tessa Lynn Hodge for Congress. Tessa has worked in local schools providing life-changing mental health support to students. Her personal experiences allow her to empathize with some of our most vulnerable youth populations. I know she will effectively represent and fight for the interests of youth in our community."
**Demócratas Del Pueblo
** “Demócratas del Pueblo is proud to endorse Tessa Lynn Hodge for California’s 23rd District. Tessa brings strong, community-centered leadership focused on supporting working families, strengthening local businesses, creating green spaces, and expanding access to healthcare. We are confident she will be a powerful voice for equity, opportunity, and the communities of District 23.”
**Melinda Neal, President Yucaipa-Calimesa Democratic Club** “Tessa Lynn Hodge is my preferred candidate. She has been born and raised in the district and has spent her professional career as a social worker, supporting local families. Last summer at an event, Tessa and I spoke one on one for twenty minutes. After that conversation, I knew who would receive my vote. Since that interaction, we have spoken at several other events...Tessa is in favor of universal health care for all...When you take a pen in hand to mark your ballot, you are not only voting for the present, but for your children’s futures and your grandchildren’s futures. Make it a better place for them. The polls open on June 2. If you plan to vote by mail, post your ballot well before that date. And please consider Tessa Lynn Hodge, Democrat, for Congressional District 23.”
---
|
---
| | **Busy Day on the Campaign Trail Last Saturday**
Tessa attended a town hall sponsored by 50501 Ridgecrest that included candidates for CA 23 and CA 20. Andrew attended the High Desert Progressive Democrats Voter Outreach Fair in Victorville. Campaign Manager Alex attended a Cinco de Mayo parade in Lake Los Angeles and handed out literature with three volunteers, including our new bilingual social media intern, Isaac! Thank you to Erika Schwerdt and Vladimir Gomez for inviting us.
---
|

|

|

|

**Canvassing Events**
**May 9 - Big Bear** \- meet at 8:30 a.m. at Perks Coffee House to carpool/caravan to Big Bear. Or you can meet us directly in Big Bear at 10:00 a.m. at Sugarloaf Park. **May 16 - Apple Valley** \- Meet at 10 a.m. at Perks Coffee House in Apple Valley. **May 23 - Yucaipa** **May 30 - Multi-city**

Email [info@tessaforca.com](mailto:info@tessaforca.com?subject=Canvassing%20Events&body=), scan the QR code below, or [click here to complete the signup form.](https://us.list-manage.com/A6cIdFBg7YA?e=db7cb92046&c2id=f83d0f9d6921da6906ad40d7e682269c)

|

| |
**A Big Thank You to Sharon Fain for our Meet and Greet** A big thank you to Sharon Fain and her family for hosting an amazing meet and greet in Yucca Valley. Another big thank you to everyone who came and asked questions, engaged in conversation, and more importantly engaged in community building! The best part of campaigning is getting to meet so many members of this community that I love and hearing their stories. I think one thing is clear, when people hear my story, my connection to the district, and my plan for how to utilize the strengths of our amazing district to improve the lives of those who live here, they see and believe in the vision and the plan. I’m looking forward to winning this primary and then flipping this seat on the general election.

Get it in the mail as soon as possible, or you can vote in person on Tuesday, June 2, 2026. In case you, your family, or friends need them, here are important links: [Check your voter status here](https://us.list-manage.com/KV6qk62Ys6u?e=db7cb92046&c2id=f83d0f9d6921da6906ad40d7e682269c). [Or register to vote here](https://us.list-manage.com/EJEzvhUdU7D?e=db7cb92046&c2id=f83d0f9d6921da6906ad40d7e682269c). **You must register to vote at least 15 days before the election.**

**Fundraising Push** Thank you to everyone who has donated to the campaign thus far. Whether it was $1 or $1000, when you're running a grassroots campaign, every dollar matters. Thanks to you we have been able to order more yard signs, 5 large campaign signs to put out around the district, 3 large banners, and we have purchased digital advertising and have a large text campaign going out over the next several weeks. At this critical juncture, every new donation helps us buy one more yard sign, one more large sign to put on a street corner, and one more text to a voter. Help us win this primary and defeat Jay Obernolte and MAGA by donating today.

Hello friends, from the bottom of my heart, thank you so much for all the support you have shown this campaign. When I first decided to run I wasn't sure where the path would lead. What I now know is that it has led to many new and amazing friendships, experiences with members of my community I didn’t know were possible, and an even greater love for our desert, our mountains, and this community we all call home. I am honored that you have all placed your trust in me, and I promise that I will fight tooth and nail every day to win this seat for you all. With gratitude and determination,

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=41295%2E3422442%2EhsGcQr)
Peter, it’s Elizabeth Warren.
We need leaders who aren’t afraid to walk into a room with rich and powerful Wall Street bankers or stand toe-to-toe with Donald Trump and still come out on top, fighting for working people.
And that’s exactly why I’m supporting Katie Porter for Governor of California.
I’ve spent my career taking on the biggest corporations and the richest executives in this country. I know what it takes to win those fights—and I know how rare it is to find someone who doesn’t flinch when the pressure comes.
**Katie Porter doesn’t flinch.**
She’s tough. She’s fearless. And she understands something some politicians forget the minute they get comfortable in office: Government is supposed to work for working people, not for billionaires and corporate donors.
California’s June primary election is just weeks away. And right now, corporate PACs and wealthy special interests are flooding this race with money because they know what Katie represents: _real accountability and real change._
Katie’s the only candidate in this race who has always refused corporate money, and she’s fighting for things that actually matter to people’s lives: universal childcare, Medicare for All, and affordable housing.
When voters hear what she’s fighting for, they respond. But only if her message reaches them—before the ads, the special interests, and the big money try to drown it out.
Katie is being outspent, so I’m asking you directly:
**[Can you chip in $5 today to help power Katie Porter’s campaign and make sure Californians hear her message?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260507_1_ak.7bCj8l&refcode=em20260507-41295&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41295%2E3422442%2EhsGcQr)**

Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20260507-41295&amounts=&t=23&refcode2=41295_3422442_hsGcQr&akid=41295%2E3422442%2EhsGcQr)**

clean_body: Peter, it’s Elizabeth Warren. We need leaders who aren’t afraid to walk into a room with rich and powerful Wall Street bankers or stand toe-to-toe with Donald Trump and still come out on top, fighting for working people. And that’s exactly why I’m supporting Katie Porter for Governor of California. I’ve spent my career taking on the biggest corporations and the richest executives in this country. I know what it takes to win those fights—and I know how rare it is to find someone who doesn’t flinch when the pressure comes. Katie Porter doesn’t flinch. She’s tough. She’s fearless. And she understands something some politicians forget the minute they get comfortable in office: Government is supposed to work for working people, not for billionaires and corporate donors. California’s June primary election is just weeks away. And right now, corporate PACs and wealthy special interests are flooding this race with money because they know what Katie represents: real accountability and real change. Katie’s the only candidate in this race who has always refused corporate money, and she’s fighting for things that actually matter to people’s lives: universal childcare, Medicare for All, and affordable housing. When voters hear what she’s fighting for, they respond. But only if her message reaches them—before the ads, the special interests, and the big money try to drown it out. Katie is being outspent, so I’m asking you directly: Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change.

body:
The special session to eliminate our district has started.
#
Peter, Wednesday marked Day One of the special session Tennessee Republicans are holding to redraw the state’s congressional maps and they’re doing this with one goal in mind: **eliminating TN-09 as a majority-Black, Democratic district.**
This has been coming for a long time, but Republicans are moving fast. Last week, Donald Trump and Senator Marsha Blackburn leaned on Gov. Bill Lee to tilt the rules in their favor, and now Gov. Lee is giving them _exactly what they wanted._
We’re fighting back on every front — inside and outside the State House. But we need your support to keep going. **[Split a $9 donation between Justice Democrats and our campaign to help us close the gap on our critical $100,000 goal to defend District 9.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260507-jjp.J-GFbU&refcode=em20260507-37750&t=2&akid=37750%2E1203867%2E0haogU)**
**[DONATE $9 TO DEFEND TN-09! →](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260507-jjp.J-GFbU&refcode=em20260507-37750&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=3&akid=37750%2E1203867%2E0haogU)**
As a sitting state legislator, I’m not watching this from the sidelines. I’m in the Capitol. I’m in committee rooms. And I’m on the streets of Memphis, with the People of Memphis to make sure they know they have someone in their corner.
Because when they come for our community’s right to representation, they’re not just shifting lines on a map. They’re trying to silence our voices permanently.
_The entire GOP’s midterm strategy is relying on power grabs_ in states like ours so they don’t have to answer to voters. That’s why they’re playing these authoritarian games in places like Florida, Louisiana, Alabama, and others, well before People head to the polls in November.
But Memphis isn’t going to allow itself to be carved up by those who have come to do us harm.
I’m continuing to fight this scheme with other Democrats who refuse to accept rubber-stamp injustice. We’re standing shoulder to shoulder with our neighbors who understand what’s at stake. And we’re fighting with everything we’ve got, because _now is the time to stand up for democracy._
To keep our momentum strong, we need real resources to meet every challenge Republicans throw at us.
**[So I’m hoping you’ll split $5 or more between Justice Democrats and our campaign in the next 30 minutes and help our Movement reach its critical $100,000 Defend District 9 goal.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260507-jjp.J-GFbU&refcode=em20260507-37750&t=4&akid=37750%2E1203867%2E0haogU)**
**[Contribute $5](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260507-jjp.J-GFbU&refcode=em20260507-37750&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=23&akid=37750%2E1203867%2E0haogU)**
More to come on this.
In Love and Service,
Justin J. Pearson

subject: We have an affordability crisis that Abbott refuses to address
body:
This isn’t just a mirage, change is actually happening in Texas.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
I was on Morning Joe this morning, Peter, and I want to share something that I truly believe:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260507_1_morningjoe.EsGcpp&refcode=em20260507-1071&amount=5&t=1&akid=1071%2E299639%2EOVhm2L)
**Change is already happening in Texas.** This isn’t happening just because — it’s happening organically, from Pearland to Leander, because Texans are looking around and realizing Republicans have had power for years and they still haven’t delivered for them.
Here’s something I keep hearing everywhere I go. Texans are working harder than ever and still getting less.
Right now, we lead the country in people getting their lights shut off. We have some of the highest rates of uninsured people and children. And we have far too many people filing for bankruptcy because life has become unaffordable.
Greg Abbott has been in charge for more than a decade, but Texan families aren’t thriving — they’re hurting. If Abbott is reelected in November, he’s only going to enable the system that benefits him and keeps leaving everyday people behind.
_But I won’t._
**As governor, I’ll fight to lower energy costs, make life more affordable, and make sure people and children are insured. I will _always_ put Texans first.**

Chloe Cole, a 20-year-old California resident and prominent detransitioner, is suing Kaiser Foundation Hospitals for medical malpractice related to gender transition procedures she underwent as a minor. Filed in 2022 when she was 18, the case represents one of the most high-profile medical malpractice lawsuits involving gender-affirming care for minors. The trial is scheduled for April 5, 2027.

Cole's medical journey began at age 9 when she began experiencing gender dysphoria. At age 12, she was prescribed puberty blockers by Kaiser healthcare providers. Shortly after turning 13, she began testosterone treatment, and within months, at age 13, she underwent a double mastectomy--a procedure she now describes as "life-altering medical mutilation."
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=196801155&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk2ODAxMTU1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzgxNzM0NDYsImV4cCI6MTc4MDc2NTQ0NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.mqntDQhqtp3wf7LKArfEgWu3LMUVEJYZ09y7xKWo0WQ)
Cole's lawyers allege that Kaiser physicians failed to provide adequate informed consent, did not properly explore underlying mental health issues, and rushed her into irreversible procedures. She subsequently suffered severe psychological distress and detransitioned several years later, recognizing that her discomfort stemmed from mental health challenges unrelated to gender identity.

The lawsuit is being handled by The Dhillon Law Group and LiMandri & Jonna LLP in conjunction with the Center for American Liberty, a nonprofit organization supporting similar cases. The complaint seeks damages for medical malpractice, alleging that Kaiser providers violated the standard of care by recommending and performing irreversible procedures on a child who could not give truly informed consent.

The case has garnered significant national attention, with Cole becoming a prominent advocate for restrictions on gender transition treatments for minors. In September 2025, Congressman Bob Onder introduced federal legislation named after her--the "Chloe Cole Act"--aiming to limit access to puberty blockers and gender surgeries for children.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.KgrC5xFcm_wKc7Y5CfqWV3J03Rb2MJJ4W4C_ESUf2K4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=196801155)
The case is scheduled for trial on April 5, 2027, marking a critical juncture in an emerging area of medical malpractice law. The lawsuit comes amid growing scrutiny of gender-affirming care practices, including a February 2026 landmark ruling in New York where a detransitioner was awarded $2 million in damages.

The American Society of Plastic Surgeons recently announced opposition to breast removal surgeries for individuals under 19, citing insufficient evidence of long-term benefits and significant risks--a position that may influence Cole's case.

If successful, Cole's lawsuit could establish significant legal precedents regarding informed consent standards for medical providers treating gender dysphoric minors, potentially exposing similar institutions to liability and reshaping clinical practices nationwide.

For more information about the life and lawsuit of Ms Cole see my exclusive podcast interview [Ep105](https://substack.com/redirect/84b41da1-442f-43f8-8ae1-172babba414c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and in my book [Songs About the Heartland](https://substack.com/redirect/3c9ac1e8-06a1-478c-b4be-318543507651?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: I almost didn't send this
body:
I’m going to be blunt with you.

| | |
---
| | Friend,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4b70paue792hnc1ftd5hpm34gum5tjtrtl4e9g0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgeeor2cth2bs)
---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Friend, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z207434kbpr89sl440rhute119dhsb98465rlgj0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgeeor2cth2bs)
---
And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

**[And Friend, I'm asking you to send backup to these brave students on the frontlines with your gift to Turning Point USA today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9ogcgu65k7kukffgeqj4er51scsep8pujg8oit8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgeeor2cth2bs)**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsd7h0sosspup5gkg2rva65g0fd5gmu39sls9gm8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgeeor2cth2bs)
---
But here's what gives me hope, Friend...

Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating.

Because every day, more students are stepping forward.

Not because it's easy or popular...

_But because they know what 's at stake. _

They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to.

They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged.

They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform.

And they're not alone.

They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day.

They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh088j6tqee5h2c1gkgt4t71er0482lsj8ao2j2g_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgeeor2cth2bs)
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zu5m8i3vpi3q1slhb04r7fvub501bl07ar531tpg_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgeeor2cth2bs)
---
That's how movements are built.

Not from the top down... _But from the ground up. _

One student. One school. One chapter at a time.

And Friend -- that's exactly how we take this country back.

But only if we move fast enough.

Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break.

They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in.

And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction...

Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes.

And once it closes... It closes for good.

That's what's at stake.

Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- _while it still matters. _

**[Please act today and send an activism kit straight to the frontlines.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0aqf664m4ut0hqbqor55bbi4hrartiit65ap6dg_rp22sh2s8i6epr0shgeeor2cth2bs)**

# Our chance to vote for peace.
---
| | Hello friends,
I am writing to remind you that ballots for the primary election have been sent out. This is a huge moment for our district and our country. Your vote is critical to ensure District 2 voters have a real pro-peace alternative this year.
**I urge you to make a plan to vote — by mail now or in person on June 2.**
Our campaign for People, Peace, and Planet is powered by people like you. To reach as many voters as possible before June 2nd, we urgently need more volunteers. Help us make calls on our Thursday phonebanks, join our postcard writing team, or explore other volunteer opportunities on our [**volunteer page**](https://us.list-manage.com/Ee0E2efLBja?e=8c53948e4c&c2id=06d66eac9b545d55bb613c1fdc65532c). Every conversation, every yard sign, and every postcard sent makes a real difference in building the momentum we need to move on to the general election. If you can, join the #PickRose team and sign up to volunteer today.

Friend,
I cannot emphasize enough just how proud I am to be Daniel’s wife. Watching him stand tall for everyone in our great state like he does for our family is truly remarkable.
Most people don’t know Daniel like I do. They only see Daniel as Attorney General or as a candidate for the United States Senate. But **I know who he is when he walks through the door at the end of a long day.**_I see the consistency, I see the strength that never falters,_ even when I know he’s tired. I see a husband who still makes time for dates. I see a father who prioritizes his children. A man who leads our family with both strength and humility, who prays not just for himself, but for our family and for the future of his nation.
**He’s the real deal. What you see is what you get.** On the road, and at home. Unfortunately that’s something that’s lacking in today’s society. It’s a rare exception to see politicians' spouses standing beside them, but trust me, _this is a man I always want to follow_. Because **he practices what he preaches. His faith is real.** **His dedication to this Commonwealth and our nation is real. And most of all, he keeps his promises. Every time.**
**I love Daniel.** _The greatest choice I made was saying yes to him when he asked me to be his wife._ I’ve never regretted it for a second. He’s a fighter, and I know he’s ready for the battle on May 19th.
[_**From the bottom of my heart, I hope you will join us by supporting Daniel ahead of the May 19th primary. name: Chris Pappas
subject: New Hampshire is now a top MAGA target
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The MAGA machine is no longer just “coming” to New Hampshire – they’ve officially moved in.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=6517%2E582294%2EGCyWpX)
Team, it’s Chris.
The MAGA machine is no longer just “coming” to New Hampshire – _they’ve officially moved in._
Turning Point Action, a far-right political operation, has opened a major field office in Manchester — and is reportedly hiring more than 120 full-time staff to spread across our state.
This isn’t a campaign stop: It’s a full-scale, paid ground operation designed to blanket our state with outside operatives and drown out Granite Staters’ voices.
**[Before I share more, will you rush a donation of $5 or more right now to give our campaign the critical boost we need to keep up with the GOP’s spending in NH?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260507_1.KRnj_t&refcode=em20260507-1&t=2&akid=6517%2E582294%2EGCyWpX)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260507_1.KRnj_t&amount=5&refcode=em20260507-1&t=21&akid=6517%2E582294%2EGCyWpX)**
Here’s the state of our race:
1. Donald Trump has endorsed John Sununu.
2. Americans for Prosperity Action is already spending heavily on his behalf.
3. And now MAGA groups are combining forces to turn New Hampshire into a top-tier battleground that could determine Senate control.

**One senior Republican operative put it bluntly:_“Put $50 million into New Hampshire, and you pick up a seat.”_**
As Turning Point and other national Republican organizations build out their ground game, we’re expecting a tidal wave of outside spending to follow — _millions more_ could be pouring into New Hampshire to try to buy this seat and cement their Senate majority.
Our campaign is powered by grassroots supporters across this state — not corporate PACs. But competing with that level of spending takes real resources, and we can’t afford to fall behind.
**[So I’m asking: Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today to help us build the grassroots campaign it will take to stand up to the flood of MAGA money coming into New Hampshire?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260507_1.KRnj_t&refcode=em20260507-1&t=22&akid=6517%2E582294%2EGCyWpX)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260507_1.KRnj_t&amount=5&refcode=em20260507-1&t=23&akid=6517%2E582294%2EGCyWpX)**
John Sununu has Donald Trump, Americans for Prosperity Action, and Turning Point Action building his ground game — so it’s clear that they’ll all fight for the same agenda if he wins.
We can win this race — but only if we build the strength now to compete with what’s coming.
Thanks for being part of this,
Chris
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

name: Dan Cox
subject: STRAW POLL VICTORY: 2 Debates, 2 Wins! & 50% of URGENT goal reached
body:
We won! Dan Cox has completed two primary debates and has won both. Now we have FIVE DAYS to reach our fundraising goal - please help today. | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
|
# Straw Poll Victory!
Help us reach our goal by May 12 - we are 50% there.
---
|
---
| Dear Dan Cox for Governor,

We are excited to announce a major STRAW POLL victory. After the most recent Primary Debate in Carroll County excellently held by upcoming GOP rising leader Ray Fava and the Carroll Republican Conference sponsored by the Tri-District North Carroll Republican Club, with five of the Gubernatorial candidates participating, **we won with 82% of the votes cast**.

With two out of two debates won, our campaign is working hard to earn your vote to send Wes Moore back to New York.

I have the will and determination to not give up the fight. As the only formerly elected candidate in this race, I have the only proven track record as a Republican fighting for you while also demonstrating ability to win friends and votes across the aisle.

As State Delegate, I passed legislation unanimously with across-the-aisle support to fight human trafficking, and I co-sponsored legislation with my colleagues to lower taxes for for senior citizens and first responders.

Statistically, those experienced former elected officials who never give up have the highest chances of being elected. body:

Dear Peter,
Last week, Governor Howard Dean endorsed Molly for lieutenant governor as well as her plan and public support for universal primary care in Vermont. Both Molly and Governor Dean testified before the Vermont legislature last week. You can read Molly’s testimony below.
Governor Dean helped expand Dr. Dynasaur so more Vermont kids could access healthcare. Now, he’s backing Molly because he knows Vermont needs bold leaders committed to making strategic, public investments that actually lower costs for all Vermonters.
Right now, healthcare costs are bankrupting Vermont families, crushing employers, and driving up education costs. Vermonters are paying more and getting less — especially in rural communities where access to primary care is disappearing.
For Molly, this issue is personal. She grew up with Dr. Dynasaur, is raising a young family, and helps care for her mother who battles multiple sclerosis. That’s why she’s fighting to ensure every Vermonter has access to primary care regardless of age, income, or zip code.
Governor Dean’s public support is the latest in a growing coalition behind this campaign. Molly has earned support from over 90 current and former Democratic and Progressive leaders across Vermont. [https://www.mollyforvt.com/supporters]
This campaign is about delivering real solutions for Vermonters, and this is just one of the ways Molly will do it. Thank you for being part of this team.
Team Molly

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/80898/images/Screen%20Shot%202026-05-07%20at%201.19.43%20PM.png]
Molly Gray
Public Hearing Testimony
Vermont House Committee on Health Care
April 30, 2026
Thank you for the opportunity to speak on access to primary care in Vermont. I am here today as a taxpayer, a mom, a caregiver to my mom, and as a candidate for lieutenant governor.
Over the last several months, I’ve heard from hundreds of Vermonters about the cost of living, health care, and education spending. I’m here to amplify those concerns and explain why I strongly support universal primary care.
Earlier this month, I met with the Hartford Professional Fire Fighters. One of the largest expenses and most frequent calls for emergency services is transporting patients to the emergency room for health issues that would otherwise be addressed through primary care.
At a recent school board meeting at Harwood Union Middle and High School, the district shared that health insurance premiums rose more than 35% over the last three years. As this Committee knows, these premiums have become the largest driver of education spending and, in turn, property taxes.
But closing schools and consolidating districts does not address health care costs and does little to truly stabilize property taxes, which fall most heavily on working Vermonters. To put it bluntly: not only is Vermont placing a failing system on the backs of our children, but also failing to deliver on a basic human right.
We know investments in primary and preventive care work.
Consider Dr. Dynasaur: For more than 30 years, Vermont children under age 19, as well as pregnant people during and after pregnancy, have been eligible for low-cost or free health coverage. This has kept kids and new parents healthy and out of the emergency rooms.
Consider the Osher Center for Integrative Health, where preventive care for Vermonters experiencing chronic pain includes conventional and complementary treatment with an emphasis on the whole person. Patients have experienced a 70% decrease in emergency room visits.
And, consider what is happening in my hometown of South Newbury where Little Rivers Health Care, whose mission is “Affordable Care for All,” has adapted its practice to meet patients where they are. They conduct home visits, so Vermonters like my mom can access quality care when a trip to the clinic is physically hard.
I don’t have all the answers, but I know we have tremendous talent in this room and across Vermont ready to act.
I encourage the Committee to propose that the Legislature establish an emergency task force mandated to urgently develop a universal primary care plan for Vermont, inclusive of funding and workforce needs, and a timeline for deployment.
I will welcome every opportunity to work with this Committee and the Legislature, in the months and years ahead, on this effort.
Thank you for your leadership and for the opportunity to speak today.

Last month, we asked JanePAC supporters all across the country a question: **Do you support lawsuits as a way to hold fossil fuel companies accountable for the harm they’ve caused?** The answer was a resounding **YES.** But let’s dive deeper into the findings: **1\. People want to use the courts to pursue accountability.** Over **96%** of you told us that you supported using lawsuits as a way of holding fossil fuel corporations accountable. _The rule of law still matters_ — regardless of what Donald Trump and his corporate cronies say or do. **2\. Elected officials should go after the perpetrators of the climate crisis.** Lawsuits don’t just _happen._ If we want to use the courts to hold Big Oil to account, we need elected officials at the state and local level who are willing to actively pursue climate justice. (This is something _over 97% of survey respondents_ agreed on!) **3\. Everyday Americans shouldn’t be saddled with the cost of the climate crisis.** Over 94% of you agreed: Oily corporations knew what their products would do to our planet, and they lied to us about it. _They_ are the ones who should be required to bear the costs of climate-related disasters like wildfires, floods, and extreme storms — not everyday Americans. Team, we gather this feedback from time to time because we use it to directly shape our roadmap for the year ahead. Now that we’ve heard opinions from folks in Cresco and all over, we’re gearing up to endorse new climate champions, mobilize voters in key races, and build the strongest possible defense against Donald Trump’s authoritarian agenda. **[If you haven’t had a chance to take our survey yet, don’t worry — the conversation is still open. Your insights will help us steer the strategic direction of JanePAC as we gear up for the critical fights ahead.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130947511/619446603/899194069?refcode=ea.7e05ff62-3a4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.7e05ff62-3a4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjdlMDVmZjYyLTNhNGEtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bZHRMPJRk96dH1r2-Rpw34EHRjtEF88tUNv72eIUMBE=&emci=0196dbfc-2a4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=7e05ff62-3a4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4823105)** | [TAKE THE SURVEY →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130947512/619446604/899194069?refcode=ea.7e05ff62-3a4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.7e05ff62-3a4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjdlMDVmZjYyLTNhNGEtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bZHRMPJRk96dH1r2-Rpw34EHRjtEF88tUNv72eIUMBE=&emci=0196dbfc-2a4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=7e05ff62-3a4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4823105)

clean_body: Here’s what you told us. | Last month, we asked JanePAC supporters all across the country a question: Do you support lawsuits as a way to hold fossil fuel companies accountable for the harm they’ve caused? The answer was a resounding YES. But let’s dive deeper into the findings: 1\. People want to use the courts to pursue accountability. Over 96% of you told us that you supported using lawsuits as a way of holding fossil fuel corporations accountable. The rule of law still matters — regardless of what Donald Trump and his corporate cronies say or do. 2\. Elected officials should go after the perpetrators of the climate crisis. Lawsuits don’t just happen. If we want to use the courts to hold Big Oil to account, we need elected officials at the state and local level who are willing to actively pursue climate justice. (This is something over 97% of survey respondents agreed on!) 3\. Everyday Americans shouldn’t be saddled with the cost of the climate crisis. Over 94% of you agreed: Oily corporations knew what their products would do to our planet, and they lied to us about it. They are the ones who should be required to bear the costs of climate-related disasters like wildfires, floods, and extreme storms — not everyday Americans. Team, we gather this feedback from time to time because we use it to directly shape our roadmap for the year ahead. Now that we’ve heard opinions from folks in Cresco and all over, we’re gearing up to endorse new climate champions, mobilize voters in key races, and build the strongest possible defense against Donald Trump’s authoritarian agenda. | Let's fight like hell for our planet. — Team JanePAC | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. # **The Capitalist exists because of you, and we want to hear from you!**
**[Become a paid subscriber today and access the Live Capitalist chat](https://substack.com/redirect/04ab0199-7398-456e-b29e-e5c0f4479f13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Subscribe here now](https://substack.com/redirect/04ab0199-7398-456e-b29e-e5c0f4479f13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Zohran Mamdani **[thought it would be a good idea](https://substack.com/redirect/2bbd466f-f236-4236-b954-942728f35581?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to film a Tax Day video directly in front of Ken Griffin's Manhattan penthouse to brag about taxing the rich.
In the grand tradition of TikTok liberals it was another tone deaf **" post now, think about the consequences later"** moment we all
know and love. It was the kind of banal, infantile, political stunt that gets hearts from leftists on TikTok and applause from the NYU Communist activist crowd.
[| | | | | Mayor Zohran Kwame Mamdani
---
@NYCMayor
Happy Tax Day, New York. We're taxing the rich.
| 8:11 PM * Apr 15, 2026 * 52M Views16.9K Replies * 31.8K Reposts * 272K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/7d96dc34-dab7-4de7-8ebb-24f98892692a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
What it also did was get 52 million views and **[guarantee that one of New York's richest employers would accelerate his move out of the city.](https://substack.com/redirect/3b3ceed9-b08c-4a24-9e3f-179ce2cf6aff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Ken Griffin didn't mince words. The message from the hedge fund billionaire was unmistakable: New York is no longer the place to be. Citadel is now "doubling down" on Miami, expanding its footprint there as a direct consequence of Mamdani's stunt. Griffin called the video "**[creepy and weird](https://substack.com/redirect/3c422b16-cdbd-4348-aef9-4456d3645dcb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** " and in "**[poor taste,](https://substack.com/redirect/5b155cdc-4983-4036-a58f-c34981a34174?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** " noting that it **[put him in harm's way](https://substack.com/redirect/5b155cdc-4983-4036-a58f-c34981a34174?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by turning him into a political target. (This is, after all, the city of Lugi Mangione.)
And just like that, what may have earned Mamdani a 271,000 likes on social media is now going to cost the people of New York a fortune in lost future revenue, jobs, and tax base.
Regardless of where you sit on the political spectrum or your personal feelings about Ken Griffin and the way he does business (and plenty of people have plenty of feelings and we at the Capitalist are no exception!) the fact remains that he has every right to take his ball and go home. Mamdani decided to make a public mockery of him, and now, surprise surprise, Griffin is pulling his money and his company's expansion plans out of New York. Who didn't see that coming?
This isn't a college campus where snide cancel-culture leftism can run wild without consequences. This is the real world. When you are the mayor of New York City and you personally target an individual citizen who employs hundreds of people (and wealthy people at that) and pays enormous taxes, you are not a bold progressive leader. You are basically acting like a wannabe Mafia don only with out the gravitas....or style.
What ever you think of yourself Zohran, Michael Corleone you are not!

# [Dead Woman Returns from Heaven with a Warning for Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/6d0f5f8c-beaf-4b50-8e05-32c57218c154?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6d0f5f8c-beaf-4b50-8e05-32c57218c154?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Have you seen this incredible video?**

An Arizona woman died, went to heaven...

**And she was sent back to Earth with[THIS message](https://substack.com/redirect/6d0f5f8c-beaf-4b50-8e05-32c57218c154?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)...**

**[A warning for all Americans in 2026.](https://substack.com/redirect/6d0f5f8c-beaf-4b50-8e05-32c57218c154?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

(You won't want to miss what she has to say.)
[Click here.](https://substack.com/redirect/6d0f5f8c-beaf-4b50-8e05-32c57218c154?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Mamdani is about to learn the hard way what every rich kid eventually discovers: you can thumb your nose at your parents who pay your bills, but don't be shocked when your allowance gets cut off. By personally targeting Griffin, he has turned a major economic contributor to the Big Apple into an adversary who is now actively choosing to invest elsewhere.
The pattern is becoming depressingly familiar. Blue-state politicians treat the wealthy like an inexhaustible ATM. They lecture them about "paying their fair share" while ignoring the fact that the top earners already shoulder the vast majority of the tax burden that they merrily fritter away. When those same high earners decide they've had enough of the ever-increasing tax burden and downright hostility, they leave. And when they leave, they take jobs, investment, and the tax revenue they and their employees generate with them.
Griffin's decision to accelerate Citadel's move to Miami is not an isolated tantrum. It is a rational economic decision. New York has made itself hostile to success. High taxes, heavy regulation, and now personal, public, political targeting have made the cost of staying far higher than the cost of leaving. Griffin is simply doing what any rational business leader (or average person) would do: moving to a place that actually welcomes investment and growth. Or at the very least, will not post up outside his house to make a TikTok video!
Ultimately, it will be the people of New York are the ones who will pay the price. Every job that moves to Miami, every dollar of investment that leaves the city, every tax dollar that doesn't go to city hall is one less dollar available for the services that Mamdani claims to champion. The working and middle-class residents he says he cares about will feel the effects through worse schools, slower transit, dirtier streets, higher crime and eventually higher taxes on their own smaller paychecks.
This is the brutal reality of "tax the rich" politics in America. Unlike moving a business from one country to another, the wealthy in America have options. They can and will (very easily) relocate to friendlier jurisdictions. The best salesperson for Florida is not Ron DeSantis, its Zohran Mamdani (with notable supporting actor performance by Governors Kathy Hochul and J.B. Pritzker, and Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson) When politicians treat the rich as enemies rather than the vital contributors they are, they eventually take the hint and leave.
Mamdani's stunt in front of Griffin's home was not courageous leadership. It was performative populism that will have savage economic consequences. The hearts and likes on TikTok will not pay the bills when the tax revenue starts to dry up. The people of New York are about to discover, as if it needed to be proved once again, that you cannot punish success indefinitely without eventually punishing everyone else.
The wealthy are not trapped. They can leave. And increasingly, they are.
New York's mayor just gave one of its most prominent figures another excellent reason to do exactly that.
Oh and Zohran, if you think we're wrong, you should go make another video, outside Jamie Dimon's house this time, and see what happens.
