| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

But for our January 6 patriots still waiting on pardons -- good individuals who answered the call to peacefully protest a stolen election -- the last five-plus years have been nothing short of a nightmare.

Luckily, **the Trump Department of Justice has rightly asked the court to vacate the charges and convictions against the unpardoned Proud Boys and Oath Keepers leaders** and dismiss the cases with prejudice.

After years of weaponized prosecutions under the Biden regime, this is the right step toward real justice.

**But a new threat has emerged -- not from the DOJ, but from the radical left in Congress.**

Congressman Jamie Raskin -- one of the most partisan Democrats in Washington -- filed an amicus brief in three separate appeals in the D.C. Circuit to defend the original jury verdicts.

**Our side 's attorneys had to drop everything and work around the clock all weekend to draft a strong opposition brief! **

The filing deadline is extremely tight -- early this week.

These patriots have been completely financially drained after more than five years of brutal legal battles, imprisonment, and persecution. Many are veterans who served our country honorably, only to be treated like enemies of the state by their own government. They simply do not have the resources to fund this critical fight on their own while still dealing with other lingering issues.

**Stand in the Gap has stepped in to raise emergency funds so their legal team can file a powerful response -- on time and with strength.**

That is why we need your help today, Friend.

Our goal is to raise at least $120,000 this week to defend the 12 individuals involved.

Every dollar you give helps protect the rule of law, push back against leftist interference, and stand in the gap for these American patriots.

**These were the patriots that the Biden DOJ pursued the hardest with politically charged trials. **
* **Stewart Rhodes (Veteran),** founder and leader of the Oath Keepers, was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 18 years in prison.
* **Kelly Meggs** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 12 years.
* **Kenneth Harrelson (Veteran)** was convicted of related felony charges and sentenced to 4 years.
* **Jessica Watkins (Veteran)** was convicted of related felony charges and sentenced to 8.5 years.
* **Roberto Minuta,** Edward Vallejo (Veteran), Joseph Hackett, and David Moerschel were all convicted of seditious conspiracy after their own months-long trial and received substantial prison sentences with federal terrorism enhancements.
* **Ethan Nordean** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 18 years.
* **Joseph Biggs (Veteran)** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 17 years.
* **Zachary Rehl (Veteran)** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 15 years.
* **Dominic Pezzola (Veteran)** was convicted of serious felony charges in the same case and sentenced to 10 years.

These individuals should never have been targeted with inflated seditious conspiracy charges in the first place.

Now, the Trump administration is finally moving to correct this injustice and vacate the convictions.

He is demanding the court appoint a special lawyer (an independent amicus) to oppose the DOJ and defend the old jury verdicts -- _essentially trying to keep the deep state 's narrative alive and continue punishing these patriots_.

Friend, **The news today is exactly what we feared.** The Tennessee State Legislature has pushed through new redistricting maps designed to silence the voices of Black voters, with communities like Memphis squarely in their crosshairs. By carving up our communities, they aren't just drawing lines on a map; they are trying to strip us of our political power, and silence our voices. They think they can choose their voters so they never have to be held accountable. __They’re dead wrong.__ ____**The Fight Ahead**
Let’s be clear:__this is not the end_._ It is the beginning of a long, necessary fight.
* **Legal Action:** We are already preparing to support the inevitable lawsuits challenging these maps. Gerrymandering of this magnitude is a direct attack on our democratic process, and it will be challenged in the courts.
* **Holding Them Accountable:** We are focused on flipping the Governor’s seat. When I'm elected, I will not stand idly by. I'll call session after session until we dismantle these unfair maps and ensure every Tennessean has equal representation.
* **Breaking the Supermajority:** Our goal isn't just to win; it’s to make it impossible for them to govern by exclusion. We are going to flip this seat, break their supermajority, and ensure every representative who voted for this disenfranchisement faces the voters in November.

**We Need You**

Before you give up on America — read this | | | [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=67ef9b776b3340b1b3584f0404ad3e55&_e=BbNEzrXmbJv84xLrdwCCqu9ikkspm9y6BvPQKOqC3UY9uO2dWXs-T_s9WJMJS2VRBXdrq5gZOUzo6jXuABpM9N0Aqx5mZPJz8YAu7BeIWrW_vl3GzsODL24-V9ckMlevQYK5ERpe22N1mUJVPqwvVSLAh3oH9VadTqXg8v6pn2_gme-lKW1rEbUnoTCZDLXxee7dFp63bSWLlFx5Z_dxy2pzKvfc-o1xliY6i9TZRWZDS5EEtYQXXbSBRDy2DCtdbA5n68ib42Qfwi9ku5YFjONu8AEifaTMa7ni8kmM76fu0mce5kbN0lIl1D82LBWqcxkBonYex_ADeRFMcw302xaljHXxbblbnDZG_bUk5pOEIPt3dWu6ik9q0LurQ4WlGUhz6n3zYF1uy6_ETJqpN-WrX41xpD8lcrBqxNvzm7zlWumh6-qpUT8SL-qQmA5GTl3Dm0ZXnqnY6rC6KxdnkBk7Hm-DyawAV2YdUrIi_bNgonELZ76iuR78xBeEo1CgBzN2e-UQJOgionaWQCbyuWfe-r1zjixSViPh-lMGKrO_co5OteYb--aMAzWN0XAyh0-8IahaJ0SabJU2zSbaeVJLc70UXPiEfRWc-xngvapvL3Q0pb6nOcsgWY1WsTxDRg2oEbzjYudF62FHD7DlhxX2rXGGNPMYN7hQzDOFK94NivThW2Z5QbdUDsYOyT5A26HcLkBatXcKfZjZP0oadg%3D%3D)
---
| | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=67ef9b776b3340b1b3584f0404ad3e55&_e=BbNEzrXmbJv84xLrdwCCqu9ikkspm9y6BvPQKOqC3UY9uO2dWXs-T_s9WJMJS2VRBXdrq5gZOUzo6jXuABpM9N0Aqx5mZPJz8YAu7BeIWrW_vl3GzsODL24-V9ckMlevQYK5ERpe22N1mUJVPqwvVSLAh3oH9VadTqXg8v6pn2_gme-lKW1rEbUnoTCZDLXxee7dFp63bSWLlFx5Z_dxy2pzKvfc-o1xliY6i9TZRWZDS5EEtYQXXbSBRDy2DCtdZFNA6DdEF7HCzPWLCAcJImQTNuk0MQ84p5mt2pvtqx9Ci_0_3pqj2_JNlgy1LWiz1LmQXnilLvogcFc6XzT4vmA0I_9YpJXI0lpRAPvdcbCryg_HNiTvW19hUjXryS8ECv9sqUlh_QUlL4eHd3EsRPECy91IFqqdaR_BFzLgA4eo9r7TgAZ1mpOOcu7BPAv4O0SaLzf4jvY-btr4JhBhsc5E4WFKSuHde0Ois2Ef9N86CDaD3fvJ97y-JWP3qCtTEwDpW9uqitVXsRbg_J-U_O6tgA-WnGsF9qhpqqMbNfealEiufEvhAixQHU7EK12zf5Ovd9vE_5abNtnw0rV1LYNFxc3HCwpnLWhB4ZHh0qexAIj3MWMan1esO2F_RDwk0F-kXlVSAF3UPu5pOe2iWW4CQ-tNlvTJvamJm40JgEQwcQdhK8pOQw8Ofr0lOBy-SeYKHdqwmwAYdgC9QfR7yQ%3D%3D)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=67ef9b776b3340b1b3584f0404ad3e55&_e=BbNEzrXmbJv84xLrdwCCqu9ikkspm9y6BvPQKOqC3UY9uO2dWXs-T_s9WJMJS2VRBXdrq5gZOUzo6jXuABpM9N0Aqx5mZPJz8YAu7BeIWrW_vl3GzsODL24-V9ckMlevQYK5ERpe22N1mUJVPqwvVSLAh3oH9VadTqXg8v6pn2_gme-lKW1rEbUnoTCZDLXxee7dFp63bSWLlFx5Z_dxy2pzKvfc-o1xliY6i9TZRWZDS5EEtYQXXbSBRDy2DCtdAJRZt-5hS4DiiF2KJMNTpFzLmovmDZB-4o8BePSV87-vM-_hVk6nsoHWxPnZRnb-h2-cqVzFexN3pDk16PzMbbeuBsgKtbqCKYzKi1hHWH_BTKKDsC1QC_-fXyi5G5GUL16eDNSMtTPD-keRfvdR5TNL-yHZUvrEcWFnqHUSwzlrEKYW3eFN6K5p4XODqlnLYkuLbh1ER_LtwRJKBR_wUIGySafaPsFoY_vkVwxfHnEMyL9TNeXnppWS73-NhQAwfLh7Pk2k_zFS-eFf05vD8y7Hjf5MpMMAg-acpKdDSjmhzc_2ee1IPZ-4EJrlNkQJd0uO6uIJWPA7E1hr9Z4ABGol8rfaehdWR8vLFFXDFmSTzoDhwuNWw2j0WLwcWeRPHGc1I_nN5NTBwJT2tzE6-WZzSM7i0O6tSpVbyM_0dLCv4AjqzBzHHQVTyQuzflsw3BmCoOhrHjxuuueggFFgbA%3D%3D)
---
_But now, Peter, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

body:
I don’t always listen to them

Peter,
You know, every now and then, my team tries to tell me how to play the game... how to be a "good politician".
But let me tell you, I'm not in this to play games or be a career politician. I'm in this to fight for what I believe in and to make a real difference.
I'm tired of the politicians who promise one thing and then do another. Who say whatever it takes to get elected, and then forget about the people who put them there.
This is Navy pilot Jen Kiggans, the Republican running in the #1 TOSS-UP race in the country.[](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)Here's the reality: we can't continue to conduct our campaign as usual if we aren't able to raise what we need to keep the lights on. The Democrats have unlimited pocketbooks, and we're struggling to keep up!
During the last election, I had to empty my war chest to pull out the victory, and now we're coming up short.

### Oona A. Hathaway recently published a lengthy anti-Trump rant claiming President Trump violated the Constitution, U.S. law, and the United Nations Charter through military action against Iran.
| | [Laura Loomer](https://substack.com/@lauraloomer)
---
| May 7
---

---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1123743&post_id=196812825&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk2ODEyODI1LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc3ODE3ODkyOSwiZXhwIjoxNzgwNzcwOTI5LCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMTEyMzc0MyIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.pcu8shqhji7jnhqGlIgoRej0zBhhmKPcSu47HKpzB4s&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

A [Yale Law School professor](https://substack.com/redirect/cd338afc-3d11-4f54-806d-845af79b4b22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who has spent more than two decades advising the U.S. State Department on international law is now [publicly accusing](https://substack.com/redirect/9df49965-cbed-48c4-863e-e6eaf172d9a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) President Donald Trump of waging an "illegal war" against Iran while continuing to serve on a State Department advisory committee.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..atQDWyLIZu4gDfTmwdUsjKFJ2Jkgih7VtSM2-OYWqpQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=196812825)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eaea3af4-0234-4eea-a389-7772488c5dfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Oona A. Hathaway, a professor at Yale Law School and Executive Editor at Just Security, recently published a lengthy anti-Trump rant claiming President Trump violated the Constitution, U.S. law, and the United Nations Charter through military action against Iran.
Hathaway has served since 2005 on the State Department's [Advisory Committee on International Law for the Legal Adviser at the U.S. Department of State](https://substack.com/redirect/d3bff24a-936c-4f5d-a18f-c61bce10a303?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), according to her official biography and federal advisory records.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1cdb66e8-7257-491d-8cb8-c617b8aa7e65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Her article,[ published ](https://substack.com/redirect/9df49965-cbed-48c4-863e-e6eaf172d9a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)by Just Security, repeatedly attacks President Trump's authority as Commander-in-Chief and portrays American military action as illegitimate under both domestic and international law.
> _" Trump's war with Iran violated the U.S. Constitution and the UN Charter," _Hathaway wrote.
She described the conflict as a "doubly illegal war" and warned it could become "triply illegal" if military operations continue beyond the War Powers Resolution's 60-day window. President Trump knows this, which is why [he told Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/13af9d88-952b-40b7-8f9f-b791aeb171be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the war was over before he breached the 60-day window.
Hathaway compares President Trump's decision-making authority to authoritarianism itself, writing that _" democracy... is incompatible with the 'one man decides' model,"_ echoing Democrat talking points that President Trump is an authoritarian. She also labels the U.S. military operation against Iran _" a war of aggression,"_ language commonly associated with left-wing anti-American activists and international tribunals hostile to U.S. sovereignty.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..atQDWyLIZu4gDfTmwdUsjKFJ2Jkgih7VtSM2-OYWqpQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=196812825)
Perhaps most outrageously, Hathaway invokes the United Nations Charter against the United States while serving on a State Department advisory body tasked with advising the U.S. government on international law matters.
Her argument hinges on three claims. First, she argues that President Trump lacked congressional authorization for military action against Iran. Second, she claims the operation violated Article 2(4) of the UN Charter because it allegedly did not meet the standard for lawful self-defense. Third, she argues continued military operations past the War Powers Resolution's 60-day deadline would render the conflict "triply illegal."
Hathaway also attacks Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in the piece for defending the administration's interpretation of the War Powers Resolution, dismissing the administration's legal position as _" impossible"_ and _" not serious."_ Perhaps Hathaway raised her concerns with other committee members, but instead of keeping her views private, she decided to publicly stab President Trump in the back in a media outlet she edits. If that was her motivation, she made a huge mistake.
The issue here is that an individual serving on a State Department advisory committee is publicly accusing the sitting President of the United States of illegal warfare while echoing the rhetoric of global governance institutions that have increasingly targeted nationalist leaders and American allies.
LOOMER UNLEASHED is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..atQDWyLIZu4gDfTmwdUsjKFJ2Jkgih7VtSM2-OYWqpQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=196812825)
Her rhetoric raises serious questions about whether she supports the growing international lawfare movement against Western leaders. Hathaway's repeated emphasis on "wars of aggression" and the authority of international legal bodies comes as the International Criminal Court has pursued politically charged cases against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, a close ally of President Trump.
The State Department's Advisory Committee on International Law is supposed to advise the federal government on matters impacting American foreign policy and legal strategy. Instead, it appears the committee has become another refuge for entrenched anti-Trump ideologues embedded inside the administrative state.
Hathaway previously served as Special Counsel to the General Counsel at the Department of Defense during the Obama administration. She is President of the American Society of International Law and has spent years promoting expansive international legal frameworks that undermine American sovereignty in favor of transnational governance systems.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b64ad24c-af03-444b-ac72-49a2b8dd70af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/644ddb00-8432-4b5e-a059-fc97e8330ffc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The American people elected President Trump to dismantle the entrenched administrative state and restore an America First foreign policy. They did not vote to preserve taxpayer-funded advisory boards staffed with individuals who openly undermine the Commander-in-Chief during an ongoing geopolitical conflict.
This isn't the first time Hathaway has publicly attacked the Trump Administration over the Iran war. She recently [signed an open letter](https://substack.com/redirect/2d9d7679-d928-4070-a770-01055d39d505?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) along with 100+ international law "experts" expressing _" profound concern... [about] serious violations of international law and alarming rhetoric."_ Her [Yale webpage](https://substack.com/redirect/9390508b-2687-4a73-99dd-39aadf03a985?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) features a whole slew of articles attacking the Trump administration, all featuring her quotes, writing, or interviews on various foreign policy topics.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6d6cb39c-795f-4df7-8fb3-3bbfae9a9482?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/043da6a1-c8c1-4e81-a15e-89ea896d088d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Secretary of State Marco Rubio should immediately review Hathaway's continued role on the State Department's Advisory Committee on International Law and determine whether someone publicly accusing the President of illegal warfare can credibly continue serving in an advisory capacity tied to U.S. foreign policy.
There also needs to be a broader investigation into how many similar anti-Trump activists remain embedded throughout federal advisory committees and national security institutions, including those who signed the open letter.
If a Yale professor serving on a State Department advisory committee feels comfortable publicly attacking the President using the language of international lawfare and global governance, Americans should ask how many more ideologues inside the system are quietly working against the administration and US foreign policy from within.

Perhaps Hathaway raised her concerns with other committee members, but instead of keeping her views private, she decided to publicly stab President Trump in the back in a media outlet she edits. If that was her motivation, she made a huge mistake. The issue here is that an individual serving on a State Department advisory committee is publicly accusing the sitting President of the United States of illegal warfare while echoing the rhetoric of global governance institutions that have increasingly targeted nationalist leaders and American allies. Her rhetoric raises serious questions about whether she supports the growing international lawfare movement against Western leaders. Hathaway's repeated emphasis on "wars of aggression" and the authority of international legal bodies comes as the International Criminal Court has pursued politically charged cases against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, a close ally of President Trump. The State Department's Advisory Committee on International Law is supposed to advise the federal government on matters impacting American foreign policy and legal strategy. Instead, it appears the committee has become another refuge for entrenched anti-Trump ideologues embedded inside the administrative state. Hathaway previously served as Special Counsel to the General Counsel at the Department of Defense during the Obama administration. She is President of the American Society of International Law and has spent years promoting expansive international legal frameworks that undermine American sovereignty in favor of transnational governance systems. | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- The American people elected President Trump to dismantle the entrenched administrative state and restore an America First foreign policy. They did not vote to preserve taxpayer-funded advisory boards staffed with individuals who openly undermine the Commander-in-Chief during an ongoing geopolitical conflict. This isn't the first time Hathaway has publicly attacked the Trump Administration over the Iran war. She recently along with 100+ international law "experts" expressing " profound concern... [about] serious violations of international law and alarming rhetoric." Her features a whole slew of articles attacking the Trump administration, all featuring her quotes, writing, or interviews on various foreign policy topics. | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Secretary of State Marco Rubio should immediately review Hathaway's continued role on the State Department's Advisory Committee on International Law and determine whether someone publicly accusing the President of illegal warfare can credibly continue serving in an advisory capacity tied to U.S. foreign policy. There also needs to be a broader investigation into how many similar anti-Trump activists remain embedded throughout federal advisory committees and national security institutions, including those who signed the open letter. If a Yale professor serving on a State Department advisory committee feels comfortable publicly attacking the President using the language of international lawfare and global governance, Americans should ask how many more ideologues inside the system are quietly working against the administration and US foreign policy from within. Incumbents consistently sitting below 50% are vulnerable, especially when voters are looking for something new. Fellow Conservative,

**As a former Navy SEAL** , I’m used to being under attack. But the lies being told by my opponents who want to serve you in the US Senate is a new one for me. Something so sipmle that I’ve said on the campaign trail, or a position I’ve taken that my opponents may disagree with? **

It’s funny how an opponent can turn pretty much anything that comes out of a campaign into a flat out lie.
**
Though I’ve been in the Minnesota Senate race for about a year now, I’m no household name by any means. But our campaign is beginning to attract the attention of voters around the state as I continue to win straw poll after straw poll **(12 and counting now).** Over the weekend we just won the Congressional District 3 straw poll by a wide margin!

**I knew I would be attacked at some point - but I naively believed it wouldn’t be so dirty or so intense.**

clean_body: I’m starting to gain some traction in the race for Minnesota Senate, and so my political opponents are starting to go negative on me. | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL , I’m used to being under attack. But the lies being told by my opponents who want to serve you in the US Senate is a new one for me. Something so sipmle that I’ve said on the campaign trail, or a position I’ve taken that my opponents may disagree with? It’s funny how an opponent can turn pretty much anything that comes out of a campaign into a flat out lie. Though I’ve been in the Minnesota Senate race for about a year now, I’m no household name by any means. But our campaign is beginning to attract the attention of voters around the state as I continue to win straw poll after straw poll (12 and counting now). Over the weekend we just won the Congressional District 3 straw poll by a wide margin! I knew I would be attacked at some point - but I naively believed it wouldn’t be so dirty or so intense. Personally, I can take the hits. I get it, my opponents see me as a threat. But here’s the deal: the Senate seat in Minnesota is too important to let petty grievances get in the way of defeating Democrats and taking back this Senate seat for the Republican Party. I know it may not be much to you, but , I can tell you that we’ll be one step closer to doubling the number of Navy SEALS who have served in the U.S. Senate. You may not know me - or even live in Minnesota, but here is what I can tell you today: I’m not running for the Senate to make contacts in D.C. that can get me a cushy job in the private sector like a lot of folks. I’m running because this country has given me every opportunity available and my service to Old Glory didn’t end when I left the military. I have a lot of fight in me, , which is why we have to send emails like this one to patriots like you. What just happened in Tennessee was an attack on Black Tennesseans and voting rights. Rushed hearings. Closed-door map-drawing and dealmaking. No meaningful public input. Derek, In case you haven’t heard, the Supreme Court recently decided _Louisiana v. Callais_ , gutting the last truly enforceable tenets of the Voting Rights Act protecting majority-minority districts. This decision comes hand-in-hand with Trump and his Republican allies’ mission to weaken the voting power of communities of color across the country. [**If you’re as fired up as we are, you can chip in here to fund our voter protection work.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-scotus-rr-april-2026?amount=7&refcode=em_20260507_7003_fr&refcode2=7003_22930333_sS4rq2&akid=7003%2E22930333%2EsS4rq2) This is a devastating gut-punch to Americans and voters of color everywhere, but Democrats are determined to fight tooth and nail to ensure the voices of _all_ Americans are heard in November and every election that follows. **Here’s our path forward:** The DNC is already working overtime on the ground in key battleground states to register hundreds of thousands of new Democratic voters ahead of November’s midterms. We’re building power in our state parties and investing nationwide to ensure they have the resources they need to win down-ballot elections this year and beyond. **_And we’re organizing across the country to reach as many voters as possible, because we must win back Congress this year._** Here’s the truth, Derek: We know this is a dark moment in our history, but by winning back Congress this year and beginning to work to win back the White House in 2028, Democrats have the ability to mitigate the harm this decision could (and likely will) cause in the upcoming years. And by putting a Democrat in the White House two years from now, we have the chance to change the balance of the Supreme Court with justices who believe in and will protect the voting rights of Americans of color everywhere. clean_body: Derek, In case you haven’t heard, the Supreme Court recently decided Louisiana v. Callais , gutting the last truly enforceable tenets of the Voting Rights Act protecting majority-minority districts. This decision comes hand-in-hand with Trump and his Republican allies’ mission to weaken the voting power of communities of color across the country. This is a devastating gut-punch to Americans and voters of color everywhere, but Democrats are determined to fight tooth and nail to ensure the voices of all Americans are heard in November and every election that follows. Here’s our path forward: The DNC is already working overtime on the ground in key battleground states to register hundreds of thousands of new Democratic voters ahead of November’s midterms. We’re building power in our state parties and investing nationwide to ensure they have the resources they need to win down-ballot elections this year and beyond. And we’re organizing across the country to reach as many voters as possible, because we must win back Congress this year. Here’s the truth, Derek: We know this is a dark moment in our history, but by winning back Congress this year and beginning to work to win back the White House in 2028, Democrats have the ability to mitigate the harm this decision could (and likely will) cause in the upcoming years. And by putting a Democrat in the White House two years from now, we have the chance to change the balance of the Supreme Court with justices who believe in and will protect the voting rights of Americans of color everywhere. body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1367%2E1086043%2EDkUSA1)
Peter, this past Saturday, I stood in Baltimore and said what I’ve always believed: In Maryland, we do not bend the knee. We are built different. **We don’t just push back — we push forward.**
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260507-1.cBWJOC&amount=5&refcode=em-20260507-1&t=2&akid=1367%2E1086043%2EDkUSA1)
It’s what I said at the launch of my re-election campaign this weekend, but I wanted you to hear it directly from me, too.
Leave no one behind isn't just a slogan. It's how I govern. It means we don't have to choose between winners and losers.
And the results speak for themselves: We've built the greatest public safety turnaround story in the country. Historic investments in public education. And delivering on lower energy costs while cracking down on price gouging.
**And we're not done yet.**
Trump’s White House has launched an all-out assault on our state and our people. But I’ll say it again: I will work with anybody, and I will bow to nobody.
[**This is going to be a fight. And I need this team behind me. Can you chip in $10 to help us build the campaign that wins in November?**](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260507-1.cBWJOC&amount=5&refcode=em-20260507-1&t=3&akid=1367%2E1086043%2EDkUSA1)

Let’s do this, Peter, together.

Peter,

No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

But for our January 6 patriots still waiting on pardons -- good individuals who answered the call to peacefully protest a stolen election -- the last five-plus years have been nothing short of a nightmare.

Luckily, **the Trump Department of Justice has rightly asked the court to vacate the charges and convictions against the unpardoned Proud Boys and Oath Keepers leaders** and dismiss the cases with prejudice.

After years of weaponized prosecutions under the Biden regime, this is the right step toward real justice.

**But a new threat has emerged -- not from the DOJ, but from the radical left in Congress.**

Congressman Jamie Raskin -- one of the most partisan Democrats in Washington -- filed an amicus brief in three separate appeals in the D.C. Circuit to defend the original jury verdicts.

**Our side 's attorneys had to drop everything and work around the clock all weekend to draft a strong opposition brief! **

The filing deadline is extremely tight -- early this week.

These patriots have been completely financially drained after more than five years of brutal legal battles, imprisonment, and persecution. Many are veterans who served our country honorably, only to be treated like enemies of the state by their own government. They simply do not have the resources to fund this critical fight on their own while still dealing with other lingering issues.

**Stand in the Gap has stepped in to raise emergency funds so their legal team can file a powerful response -- on time and with strength.**

That is why we need your help today, Peter.

Our goal is to raise at least $120,000 this week to defend the 12 individuals involved.

* **Stewart Rhodes (Veteran),** founder and leader of the Oath Keepers, was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 18 years in prison.
* **Kelly Meggs** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 12 years.
* **Kenneth Harrelson (Veteran)** was convicted of related felony charges and sentenced to 4 years.
* **Jessica Watkins (Veteran)** was convicted of related felony charges and sentenced to 8.5 years.
* **Roberto Minuta,** Edward Vallejo (Veteran), Joseph Hackett, and David Moerschel were all convicted of seditious conspiracy after their own months-long trial and received substantial prison sentences with federal terrorism enhancements.

* **Zachary Rehl (Veteran)** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 15 years.

These individuals should never have been targeted with inflated seditious conspiracy charges in the first place.

Now, the Trump administration is finally moving to correct this injustice and vacate the convictions.

**But Raskin is fighting tooth and nail to stop it. **

He is demanding the court appoint a special lawyer (an independent amicus) to oppose the DOJ and defend the old jury verdicts -- _essentially trying to keep the deep state 's narrative alive and continue punishing these patriots_.

**This need is especially urgent.**

These patriots are broke and still fighting on multiple fronts. They cannot afford to pay lawyers to defend against this latest leftist attack themselves.

In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and started working for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we needed diapers and health insurance for our growing family.
Working at Kellogg’s used to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that lets you become a homeowner, live decently, and hopefully retire someday.
But over the years, that changed. Workers were paid less. Cost-of-living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans were gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/120031/images/Screen%20Shot%202026-04-24%20at%2011.20.44%20AM.png]
Most of us had never walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines through the dead of winter if we had to. We were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks in the cold, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying union jobs.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
Following the strike, I was fired. Someone had to pay – and as union president, my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
Instead, I decided last year to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and we nearly won. I got 47% of the vote in one of the closest Senate races in the country.
Now, I’m running again for the U.S. Senate – this time against billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts – and the first poll shows us virtually TIED: 46% to 45%.
I am taking on a literal billionaire senator. We can finish what we started last year and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat for working-class people, but I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win.
Please, will you contribute to my campaign for U.S. Senate to help me defeat billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts here and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
DONATE TODAY TO DEFEAT THE MAGA BILLIONAIRES! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
I believe we can win this race and keep up the fight for the American middle class. But I’m counting on your support now to win.
Thank you,
Dan Osborn

subject: The Autism Health Summit Was a Success – Recordings Now Available
body:
** The Autism Health Summit Was a Success
------------------------------------------------------------

What an incredible weekend!

The 2026 Autism Health Summit was an overwhelming success, and we want to extend our deepest gratitude to everyone who attended in-person and virtually, supported the event, volunteered, sponsored, exhibited, and helped make this conference so impactful for families around the world.

Over three powerful days, attendees heard from leading physicians, researchers, advocates, and parents discussing important topics related to autism, including underlying health conditions, neurological support, gut health, communication, stem cell therapies, biomedical interventions, advocacy, and more. The energy, connection, and supportive atmosphere throughout the event were truly unforgettable.

For those who were unable to attend, the Autism Health Summit recordings are now available for purchase online. In addition, PowerPoint presentation slides will be available to those who purchase the recordings.
PURCHASE RECORDINGS (https://givebutter.com/2026-AHS-Recordings?mc_cid=dc524cc156&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Low-income families may also apply for a scholarship to access the recordings.
SCHOLARSHIPS (https://autismhealth.com/scholarships/?mc_cid=dc524cc156&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Upcoming Autism Health Events

Cocktails for a Cause

Wednesday, August 5, 2026
5:00 PM to 9:00 PM
The Park Club
Costa Mesa, California

TICKETS (https://givebutter.com/cocktails-4-a-cause?mc_cid=dc524cc156&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Trump National Golf Club
Jupiter, Florida

TICKETS (https://givebutter.com/ah-winter-gala?mc_cid=dc524cc156&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Save the Date for Next Year’s Autism Health Summit
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=dc524cc156&mc_eid=UNIQID

Join us April 29 through May 1, 2027, at the beautiful Legacy Resort Hotel & Spa in San Diego, California, for the 2027 Autism Health Summit. Tickets are now on sale, and pricing will increase on January 1, 2027, so secure your spot early and be part of this impactful event dedicated to education, advocacy, and hope for families around the world.
AHS 2027 (https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=dc524cc156&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Thank you again for your continued support of Autism Health and the families we serve. Together, we are creating hope, education, and a healthier future for individuals with autism and related neurological conditions.

Join Our May Autism Support Group

We invite you to join our upcoming Autism Support Group on Monday, May 18th at 5:00 PM PST for an evening of connection, encouragement, and shared experiences within the autism community.

This special gathering will include heartfelt testimonials from parents, expert opinions from professionals in the field, and meaningful conversations from families navigating autism and related neurological conditions. Whether you are seeking guidance, community, or simply a place where others understand your journey, this group is designed to provide support in a welcoming and compassionate environment.

Our Autism Support Group is a safe place for individuals and families impacted by autism to come together, learn from one another, and build lasting connections. No matter where you are on your journey, you are not alone.

Register using the link below to receive access details.
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/J0pImwv6THyXxtZOwqssjg?mc_cid=dc524cc156&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=dc524cc156&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Autism Health Inc. depends on generous donations from our community. Large or small, every donation gets us closer to achieving our goals. We are grateful for your assistance! For more information about Autism Health, visit www.AutismHealth.com

clean_body: The Autism Health Summit Was a Success What an incredible weekend! The 2026 Autism Health Summit was an overwhelming success, and we want to extend our deepest gratitude to everyone who attended in-person and virtually, supported the event, volunteered, sponsored, exhibited, and helped make this conference so impactful for families around the world. Over three powerful days, attendees heard from leading physicians, researchers, advocates, and parents discussing important topics related to autism, including underlying health conditions, neurological support, gut health, communication, stem cell therapies, biomedical interventions, advocacy, and more. The energy, connection, and supportive atmosphere throughout the event were truly unforgettable. For those who were unable to attend, the Autism Health Summit recordings are now available for purchase online. In addition, PowerPoint presentation slides will be available to those who purchase the recordings. PURCHASE RECORDINGS () Low-income families may also apply for a scholarship to access the recordings. Tickets are now on sale, and pricing will increase on January 1, 2027, so secure your spot early and be part of this impactful event dedicated to education, advocacy, and hope for families around the world. AHS 2027 () Thank you again for your continued support of Autism Health and the families we serve. Together, we are creating hope, education, and a healthier future for individuals with autism and related neurological conditions. Join Our May Autism Support Group We invite you to join our upcoming Autism Support Group on Monday, May 18th at 5:00 PM PST for an evening of connection, encouragement, and shared experiences within the autism community. This special gathering will include heartfelt testimonials from parents, expert opinions from professionals in the field, and meaningful conversations from families navigating autism and related neurological conditions. Whether you are seeking guidance, community, or simply a place where others understand your journey, this group is designed to provide support in a welcoming and compassionate environment. Our Autism Support Group is a safe place for individuals and families impacted by autism to come together, learn from one another, and build lasting connections. No matter where you are on your journey, you are not alone. Register using the link below to receive access details. REGISTER HERE () About Autism Health Inc. Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders. They get tax breaks and bailouts, while the rest of us are left with higher bills and fewer opportunities.

I know we can fix this. And together, we can build a better America.

impacts that US foreign policy has on them. That’s exactly what I did. No

clean_body: She was rescued. Many are still waiting. You can help find them. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. Her name is Alice. And this is the part most people never hear. She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker's username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI. Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker's IP address. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. Alive. Her trafficker now faces 20 years to life in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking. This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting. Still trapped. And that is why the Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the Sound of Freedom Foundation 's mission is clear: To stop the sale of God 's children. The foundation extends the reach of the Sound of Freedom film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. Our vision is simple: A world where every child is safe and free. We work with partners to prevent exploitation before it begins, support rescue operations, and equip investigators. Our partners walk with survivors as they heal and rebuild their lives. Because rescue is only the beginning. And right now, there is an urgent need. We are launching Operation Search and Rescue, a mission to connect investigators and agents, identify traffickers, and build criminal evidence. We will support real rescue operations using tools like digital tracking and face recognition. This is how children are found and how traffickers are stopped. And today, you can be part of it. And right now, your donation will be matched, dollar for dollar.A concerned Child Defense Organization has approved a $10,000 MATCHING GRANT. Every dollar you give will be doubled. $25 Gift Doubles to $50 $50 Gift Doubles to $100 $100 Gift Doubles to $200 $250 Gift Doubles to $500 $500 Gift Doubles to $1,000 Your gift goes twice as far to help find and rescue children. This is God multiplying love. Jesus said, " Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me." (Matthew 18:5) Today you can be that welcome. You can enable the search and help the rescue mission to bring a child home. Please give as generously as you can while your gift is matched. And please pray for Alice, and for the children still waiting. And for the day when every child is safe and free. Because God 's children are not for sale. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

Hi there! I’m Jane Fonda. You may know me as an actor and activist, or as someone who isn’t afraid to call out bullsh*t when I see it. Heidi Hall is that kind of person, too. Heidi has a backbone, but just as important, she has the record and ideas to back it up. **That’s why I’m reaching out today: Heidi is running in a crowded primary against a Democrat who takes money from Big Pharma and weapons manufacturers. That’s not the kind of leader who’d be accountable to people, Friend.** [**So can you join me in supporting Heidi’s campaign for CA-03 by making your very own contribution today? Heidi Hall is the kind of leader I had in mind when I founded the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. _As a former EPA official_ , she spent years holding polluters accountable. _As a three-term Nevada County Supervisor_ , she led her county's transition to electric vehicles, invested in solar, and launched her county's first-ever greenhouse gas emissions assessment. _And what excites me most is this_ : Heidi’s love for the planet is rooted in her love for people. | | | Heidi Hall has spent her three-decade public service career working with others to solve problems, protect our land and water, improve health, and build opportunities for others, all while raising two boys primarily as a single mom.

[ ](https://heidihall4cong.com/l/Uw2k19MM0qZk)

Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.

After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.

Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision »
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
After everything that’s already happened, I wish I didn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.
**[I’m asking you to split a donation between Chris Pappas and me. We’re going to do everything we can to take back Congress this November, and Chris Pappas needs your help. I just hope you know that I wouldn’t be asking if this wasn’t important.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260507_2.BO9E9m&amount=5&refcode=em20260507-2&t=1&akid=6519%2E582294%2EcJY0DR)**

Thank you.
Mark

**I came off the sidelines for one reason: Ohio families.**
Life is too expensive. Paychecks are too low. Costs are too high – utilities, health care, groceries, everything.
Ohioans see more money going out the door, and not enough money coming in.
And it’s because the system is rigged. Too many Ohioans are getting the short end of the stick while people in power are doing favors for billionaires and corporate special interests. You are working harder than ever, but you can’t get ahead.
But instead of working to bring down costs and taking on corporate interests, politicians in Washington are making things worse. Politicians like Jon Husted.
Ohio deserves better and Ohioans are showing up and insisting on change. This is an important step in that fight because it brought us _one step closer_ to flipping this seat and retaking Senate control.

A new poll shows me down by 3 points. National Republicans are pouring $81 million into Ohio to defeat us – more than they’re spending in any other battleground state. And Jon Husted’s super PAC just launched a seven-figure ad buy attacking me.

subject: Experience should matter in Maine’s Senate race
body:
David’s new Portland Press Herald op-ed makes the case for real experience, real reform, and real change in Washington.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/zWe_AnfF4jn?e=5d7176e969&c2id=0715660f99493bd2d61bdbd7e3d6dd36)
| | | | [|

| | | | | | | | | | | |

Friends,
Please check out the Op Ed below, which was posted in yesterday’s Portland Press Herald.

**Portland Press Herald May 6, 2026****In Maine’s US Senate race, experience should matter | David Costello** There’s still time to determine who’s best qualified to take on Sen. Susan Collins in November. I believe I am that candidate. **David Costello** _of Brunswick is a Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate._ While many, including most in the press, have declared Maine’s Democratic U.S. Senate primary over, there’s still time for voters to consider whether the Democratic Party’s presumptive nominee is the best person to take on Sen. Susan Collins in November. Perceptions of political viability can, and often do, change overnight.
I believe that my personal story, education and government experience contrasts more sharply with that of Sen. Collins than does Graham Platner’s.
My lived experience is rooted in many of the same challenges working-class Mainers face every day, and my extensive government service is broader, deeper and more hands-on than Sen. Collins’. Moreover, I believe that my experiences equip me with the kind of knowledge and perspective sorely needed in Washington today.
I was born in Bangor and raised in Old Town by my mother and mill-working grandparents. My father, an Army veteran and labor organizer, died at the age of 31 due to hazardous working conditions he faced as a teenager. I know what it’s like to have to hustle to pay bills, compile years of debt and go long periods without health insurance and healthcare.
Like many in Maine, I began working at an early age and worked my way through the University of Maine, George Washington University and the London School of Economics. And I subsequently served for more than 30 years in senior-level government and non-governmental organization positions, both in the United States and abroad.
These positions included serving as a top aide to Maine’s secretary of state, the mayor of Baltimore and governor of Maryland; as a deputy and acting secretary of the Maryland Department of the Environment; and as a county program manager and regional team leader for the United States Agency for International Development (USAID-OTI). These positions involved implementing and managing, not simply legislating or talking about, complex multimillion-dollar programs and operations.
These programs and operations included working closely with the U.S. Army, State Department, United Nations and foreign aid organizations overseas — and various state and local government agencies, businesses and non-governmental organizations in Maine, Maryland and elsewhere.
They are programs and operations that resulted in election and motor vehicle safety reforms in Maine; improved schools and family assistance programs in Baltimore; the implementation of ambitious job creation, education, healthcare, crime reduction and environmental protection programs in Maryland; and the completion of more than 3,500 peace and community-building projects in conflict-torn Cambodia, Haiti, Bosnia, Croatia, Kosovo and Serbia.
I believe experience matters, but so too does my decades-long commitment to substantially reforming our nation’s governing practices and institutions and eliminating the excessive and corrupting influence that money, wealth and disinformation have over our politics and government.
I am also fully committed to enacting far-reaching legislative and constitutional reforms to not only salvage our democracy, but to also better protect our rights and freedoms and to enable us to finally tackle such pressing challenges as: unaffordable housing and healthcare; insufficient retirement security; economic inequality; gun violence; shoddy infrastructure; and climate change. Because only then are we likely to achieve the more perfect union envisioned by our most thoughtful founders and forebears.
The contrasts between my lived and work experiences and reform agenda and Susan Collins’ couldn’t be starker. Given this, I believe that I am the best qualified of the two remaining Democrats on June’s ballot to challenge and defeat Sen. Susan Collins in November.
As always, please consider joining us in making the case for real change in Washington and supporting David’s efforts to succeed by sharing this Op Ed with others and contributing any dollar amount that works for you, to help in ramping up our campaign activities.
Thank you,Team Costello

============================================================

Good afternoon!

We’re excited to invite you to the Grand Opening Celebration of the newly improved San Bruno Mountain Day Use Area!

Join San Mateo County Parks, California State Parks, and community members as we celebrate exciting new improvements that make this beautiful outdoor space more welcoming and accessible for everyone.

📅 Wednesday, May 13, 2026
⏰ 11:00 AM
📍 Saddle Area – San Bruno Mountain
555 Guadalupe Canyon Parkway, Brisbane, CA

The improvements include:
✅ ADA-accessible picnic areas
✅ Brand-new restroom facility
✅ Interpretive pavilion & displays
✅ Scenic mountain views
✅ Family-friendly outdoor gathering space

Enjoy a fun community ribbon-cutting celebration, photo opportunities, and the chance to explore one of our county’s most scenic outdoor destinations.

Bring a picnic, enjoy the fresh air, and celebrate this exciting park improvement project with us!

We hope to see you there. Please RSVP to Mike: ** mrichardson@smcgov.org (mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org?subject=May%2013th%20Event%20)

David J. Canepa

**Saikat Chakrabarti has built his entire campaign on one claim: that he's AOC's guy.**

There's just one problem. She won't say his name.

This week, the _San Francisco Chronicle_ reported that AOC has endorsed candidates in races across the country, but not Saikat, her former chief of staff. In fact, when asked directly, she avoids ever saying his name.

* Saikat publicly mocked Nancy Pelosi's leadership.
* And today, not a single sitting Member of Congress has endorsed Saikat’s campaign.

**San Francisco can't afford a freshman with no allies. Our next member needs to work _with_ the very colleagues Saikat spent years attacking - not against them.**

There's only one candidate in this race with the experience to deliver for San Francisco: Scott Wiener.

Scott has passed more than 100 bills in California to tackle the housing crisis, save public transit, and stand up to Trump's secret police. Now he's running for Congress to take those fights to Washington.

name: David Hogg
subject: Meet Ruwa Romman
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Ruwa Romman is exactly the kind of fearless, people-powered leader we were built to back.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260507-1&t=1&akid=3452%2E587540%2EmkKZ9u)
Exciting news, Peter:
**I’m proud to announce that Leaders We Deserve is endorsing Ruwa Romman’s campaign for Georgia State Senate in District 7!**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260507_1_ruwa.uNwQWR&refcode=em20260507-3452&t=2&akid=3452%2E587540%2EmkKZ9u)
Ruwa has been organizing Georgians since 2014, volunteering in every single election cycle to help flip the state blue. In 2020, she co-founded the Georgia Volunteer Hub that mobilized thousands of volunteers for the Senate runoffs that helped flip the chamber and change the balance of power in Washington.
When she won her House Representative seat in 2022, she made history as the first Muslim woman elected to Georgia’s State House and first Palestinian American ever elected to public office in the state. And she’s been fighting hard for her community ever since.
**[I’ll tell you more about Ruwa, but first, her primary is coming up _fast_ on May 19. This race is hers to win, but she needs your grassroots support to get there. Will you split a $5 donation between Ruwa and Leaders We Deserve today to help us power her to victory?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260507_1_ruwa.uNwQWR&refcode=em20260507-3452&amount=5&t=3&akid=3452%2E587540%2EmkKZ9u)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260507_1_ruwa.uNwQWR&amount=5&refcode=em20260507-3452&t=4&akid=3452%2E587540%2EmkKZ9u)**
As a House representative, she introduced the first statewide data center moratorium in the country, because she knows that data centers are draining water supplies, skyrocketing Georgia Power bills, and permanently impacting communities that never even had a say in those decisions. She introduced legislation to end the tax breaks Georgia Republicans handed to corporate landlords — because in a state with some of the highest rates of corporate homeownership in the country, working families are being priced out of their own neighborhoods. And when ICE started terrorizing immigrant communities, she stood strong with her neighbors to protest their cruelty, and authored and co-sponsored legislation to ban ICE from schools, hospitals, and places of worship.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260507_1_ruwa.uNwQWR&refcode=em20260507-3452&t=5&akid=3452%2E587540%2EmkKZ9u)
In Georgia’s State Senate, Ruwa will hit the ground running. She’ll fight to expand Medicaid, because Georgia is one of the last states in the country still refusing to do it, and 18 rural hospitals have closed as a direct result of that decision. She’ll introduce legislation to enshrine free state breakfast and lunch for every Georgia student into law so no kid has to learn on an empty stomach, and raise Georgia’s abysmal $5.15 minimum wage to at least $15 an hour. She’ll protect the voting rights that are under attack across the South, and use 10% of Georgia’s budget surplus to invest in a first of its kind cancer research hub to generate revenue to reopen hospitals and bring new jobs to her constituents.
**District 7** is an open blue seat, and winning the primary on **May 19** is _everything_. Ruwa is in a four-way primary, and the field is competitive — but none of her opponents bring what she does: Over a decade of organizing experience, a proven legislative record, and the kind of grassroots infrastructure that wins tight races. Ruwa has already done the hard work in this district, for these communities. **That’s why she’ll win.**
But she needs resources to get over the finish line. She doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs or special interests. Her campaign runs entirely on grassroots support, from people like you who believe Georgia deserves bold, fearless leadership that will actually fight for and protect working people.
**[Will you split a $5 donation between Ruwa and Leaders We Deserve right now to help her win on May 19?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260507_1_ruwa.uNwQWR&refcode=em20260507-3452&amount=5&t=6&akid=3452%2E587540%2EmkKZ9u)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260507_1_ruwa.uNwQWR&amount=5&refcode=em20260507-3452&t=25&akid=3452%2E587540%2EmkKZ9u)**
Thank you,
David Hogg

Another mission begins in Phoenix. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there. Alone. There was no bathroom. Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. This rescue was possible because people chose to act. The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues. | | | | | Children like Kristen are waiting. It's National Nurses Week, Peter.

Kim has spent her career in medicine, and she'll be the first to tell you: **nurses are the backbone of our healthcare system.** They're the steady hands, the calm voices, and the people who make sure patients are seen, heard, and cared for.

They work long hours, deal with emotional strain, and are often forced to navigate a system that asks far too much while giving too little in return. And right now, it's getting harder because, across the country, nurses are being stretched thin.

Hospitals are understaffed, costs are rising, and once again, politicians in Washington are pushing policies to undermine our healthcare system even more. That has looked like: major cuts to Medicaid, slashed funding for rural hospitals, and fueling fear and mistrust among patients with misleading, unscientific claims—putting countless lives at risk.

When that happens, it doesn't just impact patients. It puts even more pressure on the nurses and healthcare workers who are already doing everything they can to hold the system together. If we truly appreciate nurses, then our government needs to start acting like it. That means making sure they have safe working conditions, protecting access to care so they're not forced to make impossible choices, and standing up for a healthcare system that works for everyone.

[**Join Kim in standing with our nation's healthcare workers not just today, but every day, by demanding a healthcare system that supports our nurses and the patients who rely on them every day. That has looked like: major cuts to Medicaid, slashed funding for rural hospitals, and fueling fear and mistrust among patients with misleading, unscientific claims—putting countless lives at risk. When that happens, it doesn't just impact patients. It puts even more pressure on the nurses and healthcare workers who are already doing everything they can to hold the system together. If we truly appreciate nurses, then our government needs to start acting like it. That means making sure they have safe working conditions, protecting access to care so they're not forced to make impossible choices, and standing up for a healthcare system that works for everyone.
