name: Letlow for Louisiana
subject: LETLOW CALLS ON FLEMING TO RESIGN
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
Fleming is cashing checks from a DC lobbying firm while holding statewide office

| | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ZFBzCOCk0RW?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a)
| | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** May 7, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)

**LETLOW CALLS ON FLEMING TO RESIGN** _Fleming confessed that he is a paid, active employee of a DC Lobbying Firm while serving as Louisiana State Treasurer and running for Senate_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Today, Congresswoman Julia Letlow called on John Fleming to immediately resign from The McKeon Group. Fleming confessed during the Moon Griffon debate that he remains a paid, active employee of the lobbying firm while serving as Louisiana State Treasurer.
Fleming [confirmed](https://us.list-manage.com/fxMXBtXJdza?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a) that he is currently employed and paid monthly by a DC lobbying firm while also holding a statewide office of public trust. His financial disclosure, filed under penalty of perjury, lists $41,500 in salary from The McKeon Group, Inc. and $120,217 in salary from the State of Louisiana.
Fleming’s disclosure states that he served as a Principal at McKeon Group from February 2021 to January 2024, then continued as an Advisor from January 2024 to present. He is still listed on their [website](https://us.list-manage.com/IovyBAB7bQX?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a) as an employee.
“ _John Fleming should immediately resign from The McKeon Group and release a full accounting of the work he has performed for the firm while serving as Louisiana State Treasurer,”_ **said Congresswoman Julia Letlow.** _“Louisiana deserves public servants who are focused on serving our people, not elected officials who are collecting a taxpayer-funded salary while remaining on the payroll of a Washington lobbying firm.”_
**Letlow called on Fleming to release the following records:**
* Any contract, employment agreement, or compensation arrangement between Fleming and The McKeon Group.
* A full list of McKeon Group clients Fleming has worked on or advised since becoming State Treasurer.
* The dates and amounts of all payments Fleming has received from The McKeon Group since January 2024.
* Any ethics guidance or disclosure provided to the Louisiana Board of Ethics.
* Any recusal records involving matters connected to McKeon Group clients.
* Any communications with federal officials, congressional offices, or agency personnel on behalf of McKeon Group or its clients.

**Following the debate, the Letlow campaign also called on Fleming to immediately answer the following questions:**
* Did Fleming receive a formal advisory opinion from the Louisiana Board of Ethics approving his continued paid employment with The McKeon Group?
* Did Fleming perform McKeon Group work during state business hours or use any taxpayer-funded resources for firm business?
* Has Fleming used his title, relationships, or access as State Treasurer to benefit The McKeon Group, its clients, or prospective clients?
* Has The McKeon Group used Fleming’s title as Louisiana State Treasurer in pitches, client conversations, business development materials, or federal funding discussions?
* Has Fleming taken any official action as State Treasurer involving an entity that was also a McKeon Group client, prospective client, affiliate, contractor, or partner?
* Is any portion of Fleming’s compensation tied to federal funding, client success, lobbying outcomes, business development, or client retention?
* Will Fleming release his full contract with The McKeon Group, all payment records, all client assignments, and all ethics correspondence related to his outside employment?

Learn more at [JuliaLetlow.com](https://us.list-manage.com/CRDEUpB2xkV?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a).

Peter,
There’s no sugarcoating it: Donald Trump and his allies want a country where the richest people in the room call the shots — and working people are left divided, distracted, and fighting over what’s left.

We started Small Town PAC to help Democrats fight back and organize in the places too many politicians have written off — and to support candidates who stand with working people, take on the billionaires and tech bros trying to buy our elections, and give their communities the representation they deserve.
**That’s exactly why we’re proud to support Graham Platner for U.S. Senate in Maine. Graham is a combat veteran and an oysterman. He knows what it means to work hard, serve his country, and live in a community where people look out for one another.**

Graham’s race against Susan Collins is going to be one of the toughest and most expensive Senate races in the country. Control of the Senate could come down to Maine.

This is about whether Democrats are willing to expand the map with leaders who know the difference between a photo op and doing the work — leaders who will fight for schools, jobs, health care, child care, paid leave, and the real-life stuff too many politicians ignore.
Graham understands that. He’s rooted in his community, he knows what working people are up against, and he’s ready to fight for the places too many politicians have abandoned. That’s why I’m asking you to stand with him today.

BREAKING: Winnie approves of this human
Hi Peter, it's Winnie! 🐾 [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130960404/619489745/57398372?refcode=em26_260508_resend_fndd_gq_act___WB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260508_resend_fndd_gq_act___WB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=48cfade9-5b4a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDhjZmFkZTktNWI0YS1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=r9qi5QCI5fdhZHYbiBfZhH8O_witijQCBtrE6UCsfSA=) Yes, _that Winnie._

First Pup of Kentucky, professional Good Girl, and official judge of human character (unpaid, but highly accurate). And yes, in case you were wondering, I actually am writing this myself (my dad is probably going to have to get a new keyboard after this one, I can only do so much with paws and no fingers).

I felt it was important to share something I've learned in my line of work: dogs are the best judges of character. We don't care about speeches or headlines. We care about who shows up, who's kind, and who remembers where the treat drawer is. And I can confirm: **Andy Beshear is a very good dad.**

I've been observing him closely from my important office position (his chair), and I've reached a firm conclusion. He works hard for Kentucky families, and not just in the "looks good in photos" way — in the real, everyday way that actually matters. He's focused on helping people across the state and beyond, bringing good jobs and opportunities home, and trying to make things a little steadier for families who need it most. body:
Colorado loses businesses at one of nation’s highest rates, new report finds
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Under the Golden Dome...** With six days left in session, lawmakers are pushing major tax, spending, and transparency proposals. [Gov. Jared Polis signed 25 bills](https://link.email.joinrmv.) affecting areas including farmworker overtime, school safety, and restrictions on lawmakers holding multiple offices, while debate continues over SB-135’s [proposed TABOR changes](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and a [bipartisan lobbying transparency bill](https://link.email.joinrmv.) opposed by the governor’s office passed.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Colorado ranked among the nation’s [worst states for business losses in 2024](https://link.email.joinrmv.), with nearly 4,000 more closures than openings and the country’s highest job losses tied to business turnover. Meanwhile, Denver is battling the Trump administration over [assault weapons restrictions](https://link.email.joinrmv.), Michael Bloomberg’s support for Sen. Michael Bennet’s gubernatorial bid [reached $2.5 million](https://link.email.joinrmv.), and new scrutiny is growing over outside Democrat-linked funding behind an effort to [redraw Colorado’s congressional map](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** The Trump administration’s DOJ says its challenge to Denver’s gun restrictions could ultimately lead to a [Supreme Court ruling protecting AR-15 ownership nationwide](https://link.email.joinrmv.) under the Second Amendment. At the same time, a separate Supreme Court fight is testing whether [federal agencies like the Bureau of Land Management have too much authority](https://link.email.joinrmv.) to create and enforce criminal regulations without direct congressional approval.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, May 7, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado loses businesses at one of nation’s highest rates, new report finds](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Colorado residents have spent years watching prices climb while business groups warn that operating in the state is becoming harder.
[A new report](https://link.email.joinrmv.) adds another layer of data to those concerns.
Colorado ranked near the bottom nationally for net business establishment growth in 2024 and recorded the nation’s worst employment losses tied to business openings and closures, according to a new analysis from the Common Sense Institute.
While most states added businesses and jobs last year, Colorado was one of only six states to lose ground in both categories, joining Massachusetts, New York, North Carolina, Oregon and Washington. Researchers pointed to high business costs and weakening confidence in Colorado’s economic outlook as growing warning signs.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**

Celebrate America’s 250th and Colorado’s 150th with with 2000+ patriots: two unforgettable days of speakers, action, community, and FUN for the whole family at the Douglas County Fairgrounds.
_America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once._
Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[SEE YOU THERE!](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Transparency for All, Not Just Some](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY REP. DUSTY JOHNSON, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Bipartisan bill pushes for equal lobbying disclosure rules:** SB26-147 passed, requiring the governor’s office staff and executive branch employees involved in lobbying to follow the same transparency and reporting standards as private-sector lobbyists.
* **Supporters say taxpayers deserve accountability:** Backers of the bill say it closes a loophole by requiring publicly funded officials influencing legislation to disclose which bills they support, oppose, or amend.
* **Polis administration opposes measure despite broad support:** Critics say the governor’s opposition raises concerns about transparency and the growing influence of unelected staff in shaping legislation behind the scenes.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Is every government employee a cop now? Supreme Court case tests federal power](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [GREGWALCHER.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Supreme Court case challenges expanding federal police powers:** A new case asks whether Congress improperly allowed agencies like the Bureau of Land Management to create and enforce criminal laws without direct approval from elected lawmakers.
* **BLM arrest over dirt bike taillight sparks legal fight:** The case centers on a Nevada man arrested and threatened with jail time for riding a dirt bike with a broken taillight on public land—an offense that would normally carry only a small civil fine under state law.
* **Critics warn unelected agencies are gaining too much authority:** The commentary points to more than 200,000 armed federal officers spread across 103 agencies and argues the case could become a major test of constitutional limits on executive branch power and the separation of powers.

**[How the nation’s largest teachers union taught schools to cut parents out](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | MAY 5** _In April 2025, Dustin Gonzalez stood before the Jefferson County school board and told them what had happened to his family. A school-appointed therapist in Lakewood, he said, had affirmed his daughter’s gender transition without his knowledge._
__
**[“Time to walk the talk”: Rich Guggenheim launches Republican challenge in Senate District 25](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MAY 5** _A couple of Republican women called Rich Guggenheim and asked if he’d be interested in running for office. His first instinct was a joke. “Running what? Running my mouth? I can definitely... I’m really good at doing that.” When they told him it was Senate District 25, he recognized the seat right away. “Nobody else wants to run, huh?”_ __

**[National Small Business Week: Signs of Rising Optimism in Colorado](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY JUSTIN EVERETT | COMMENTARY | MAY 4** _This National Small Business Week, May 3-9, we’re not just celebrating America’s entrepreneurs – we’re seeing the results of policies that are putting them back in the driver’s seat. Across Colorado and the country, small businesses are growing, hiring, and investing again – and they have the confidence to do it. That didn’t happen by accident._

**Tonight, I'll share my vision for a stronger and more affordable Colorado. **

My plans take on the most urgent challenges facing Coloradans today – the same concerns I’ve heard again and again on the campaign trail: students wondering how they’ll secure a good-paying job after graduation; young couples questioning whether homeownership is within reach; and parents struggling to balance the rising costs of both child care and care for aging loved ones.
It also stands in contrast with the vision – or lack thereof – offered by my opponent, Phil Weiser.
**Phil is running more on bumper-sticker political slogans than tangible plans. And his record is defined by fighting when it helps him politically.**
_As governor, I'll always put Coloradans’ best interests over politics._

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. **Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you.** **[In light of America’s 250th birthday and the special opportunity we have to honor veterans this year, will you chip in today to help support the parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=81ff664489a849d0ad8fb7019f225ec4&_e=AjlauK16gPRAIv0ma4ubw5sMdWUf8itxonfV6z65Rr5KJYzZ5Fkh8VnOOMCslvUyFbLYC1zBlE4aVqocIwTTqidJ7asJCP4HaBK0JOhJ1bi1qDm_bMGsePnC1iUZF33N-e3hz6-0jkGznyhWd9RPXFgyN5VP4sS9RCkM8RnsBeWlOo2JdspKCQDZ9hqArtltCfKBr23Gen7KD9wsyEaJ3vdl2PRvtFVwf3WlFyxvckdBXepqrgkkwHk9MWOEH3G8vd7MFAQ2voSHsCOm7kVGR_rQnPI5Ns1CmtEvarhu9H97J6ScJylDNVQ16knacnybicZPoKijwb3fWReVbb6e1PdXGzLz1cvTq0kKO6E22d4kREM2_5fIUNgJPHQ62qq69UJJq_gPjWsh2l0oe4E8enIjqgQoeH0KpbqPzjfzv5AplJVheY1QeDPGnQlY9HQ4RGEmRJF5FW4O050yUDWPY-XDdnBGKFxYHUkfXsHtMvrxGfuzERD4cJ9lSTmxzoM8NskqxbSCUNmnGI2beYYhBtXNAnSLqedcslKghwPZSnS-nwDVDcsLt-sSJQaFSKsaaw3KO9ozDKtOBTly6A6C6pS1pu-4OTB0S0gPvdM4oh9A21cnBeGKjPxZnInJ_psqP0NDLZsTG9Doo9soTVfF0n6mTVzWPybYs-tHYGVuwK4xzb-9_B3Raisd6At9Eo8P)**

On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. **Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. ** [**And please, if you’re able, make a gift to fund the National Memorial Day parade right now during America’s 250****th****birthday.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=81ff664489a849d0ad8fb7019f225ec4&_e=AjlauK16gPRAIv0ma4ubw5sMdWUf8itxonfV6z65Rr5KJYzZ5Fkh8VnOOMCslvUyFbLYC1zBlE4aVqocIwTTqidJ7asJCP4HaBK0JOhJ1bi1qDm_bMGsePnC1iUZF33N-e3hz6-0jkGznyhWd9RPXFgyN5VP4sS9RCkM8RnsBeWlOo2JdspKCQDZ9hqArtltCfKBr23Gen7KD9wsyEaJ3vdl2PRvtFVwf3WlFyxvckdBXepqrgkkwHk9MWOEH3G8ynvIL3b_lr-4Ke5elAozrtT0QYEZCuyB9xMA7geaJnyOO5G1GVwvBOkdkwYAuDxVA8KJ0RWJUYoDBRndD1YKaMwUaNT4iQk8upE4mD9tIFF6HGNvfeN28XPZe--S2lA4MM7Wck_eJiOg-R6SSuEAKyJiERjfLc1ErvNhIeZkNBP7gAjV9d4VQhxKS3MNf2ZsvYygMuT6zK_D62TgWWK7-ETXXTDNCYFBXDFI42cwyB80I6eFimubxhJv-0fPXKeZBGbfdwUhGpFsVCjVnuRCVEQHFNIZki58Xl9eU0Jdc8z6LGt9gfM8yJQgBXVD46v64skrN_NQHz7qrOZX88dHb1dV-Ipnw06JvvlZrDbEaHbGMAnG7390w0Mt-qUjuNWqxB0kqEDSryTxnJ7YAbyF9io3b7bTCIUWHPP-d9_KqFm_im0vDSvMUVevBGDFL5YubrUUFClOSSO0MEPaEPuMng%3D%3D)

clean_body: As America turns 250, we must honor them while we can | | | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Tim Holbert President American Veterans Center | | | The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. body:
Dear Patriot,
They charged a cop with a felony for stopping a riot. I am not making this up.
They want to lock him away for using **non-lethal bean bag rounds** against a violent mob that was blocking an interstate highway, hurling rocks at officers, and bringing Molotov cocktails to the party.
I have seen a lot in my years in law enforcement. I have seen politics poison the justice system. But what is being done to Officer Jeffrey Teng of Austin, Texas is one of the most shameless, stomach-turning betrayals of law enforcement I have ever witnessed.
** [It has to stop — and I need your help to stop it.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d2ff284f6efa4a07b6956a74ad3cd04b&_e=-StKWdNDfVA9pPF4A9TLFF1OcWicflhi2Z9jcmMvAx34ku4HYx8fYAoJ9Yxo2K45Gc8ELvuGMfMzcEiW_W3z5Vuw8B4yjJwEI5LbleBICJGtN26BrrisG4mWeJjTgkgzBYTJeUMixmqJRc2dCD5w6iVnCrI4Fv8200lVfisWSRv3fESlYMDDVG5W_oVaItbZpixrM-YYkalKwPD1t8USbjaXA_vna0ufVjNGOWbmLcwKEBa-dzlvuKgI-gLtGMv5UhPwec8oL_6E-xKt-r_-l2k85yJL9SQV9heZREThQUbtpCA05UMWlxHLYgt14TtIfwQT1_MChtBg-9alBIAOeLSzmwoQLzPkM7da4R5m8Vi70WkeN-1C6S5D728xeHj9dDKPHsitaiZLvYgHGMbknPrnNZdVkKaqBXsecUk-DxIcVJyw9JMf4ELfhU3Tpz0_) **
It was Memorial Day weekend, 2020. Hundreds of protesters flooded the streets of Austin. What started as a demonstration turned into three days of chaos: buildings looted, police vehicles set on fire, a rioter caught with a Molotov cocktail before he could throw it. It took nearly Austin's entire 2,100-officer police force to keep the city from total collapse.
On May 31st, a mob completely shut down I-35 — a major interstate highway — directly in front of police headquarters. Ambulances couldn't get through. Officers gave verbal orders to disperse. A police helicopter broadcast commands over a loudspeaker. The rioters refused.
**Officer Jeffrey Teng and his partner were ordered in to clear the highway.**
Officer Jeffrey Teng with his wife
When they arrived, the mob started throwing rocks. One of those rocks struck Officer Teng's partner square in the chest. Under attack, outnumbered, doing their jobs — Teng and his fellow officers deployed non-lethal rounds to stop the violence.
That's it. That's the "crime."
Now Jeffrey Teng, along with 4 other Austin police officers, faces felony charges. Meanwhile, District Attorney José Garza has dismissed nearly every charge against the actual rioters. The people who threw rocks, set cars on fire, and shut down a highway walk free. The officers who stopped them are being prosecuted.
This is a political vendetta by a DA who has made it his mission to destroy the men and women who keep order in our streets.
And Jeff Teng is paying the price. His career is on hold. His future is uncertain. His trial has been delayed again and again — meaning this family has been living under this cloud for _years_ with no end in sight.

#
Friend, I'm Mitchell Berman, the Democrat running to flip Wisconsin's 1st Congressional District.
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22703?source=em20260507-1623&t=1&akid=1623%2E2118727%2E4kb6Zv)
**I'm a lifelong Wisconsinite, proud father, and dedicated Packers Fan.** I've been a proud union worker at each organized facility I have worked for, and am honored to have the support of the UAW in this race.
I'm also an Emergency Room nurse, splitting time between shifts at the hospital and running this campaign. At work, I listen to dozens of patients every week and hear personally what working folks are struggling with. _And that's why I know our district is ready for a change._
**Our opponent is Bryan Steil, a do-nothing Congressman who fakes a moderate persona while siding with Trump on every issue.** When he does introduce legislation, it's pure B.S. like:
❌ The “Make Elections Great Again” Act (_a shameless attempt at voter suppression_)
❌ The so-called "Stop Insider Trading Act" (_which doesn't actually stop insider trading_).
The good news is that this year is our chance to unseat him. Trump only won 51% of the vote here in 2024, and Justice-elect Chris Taylor won our district by an impressive margin in her election earlier this year.
**Friend, this is one of the closest swing districts in one of the biggest swing states in the country, and I'm the type of candidate who can flip it.**

body:
A bright red line in the law.
#
Did you see this?
Tom Homan has long had a pattern of issuing threats that he does not have the right or ability to carry through.
He has threatened to put me in jail if we resisted or opened investigations. So we need to know who we’re dealing with here.
The fact of the matter is, New York City already has sanctuary laws on the books that say that if someone commits a crime, they have to go through our system.
If ICE wants to go in, they have to do so using their own resources.
**That is a bright red line in the law that we are all required to adhere to**.
The law doesn’t change if you threaten it.
The law doesn’t change if you stomp your feet about it.
We all have to respect it.
**We do not have to comply with illegal activity** — even if that illegal activity is coming directly from the President of the United States and his cronies in the administration.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Military deployed to the polls?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2451%2E135344%2EKU_TQu)

President Trump has continued to threaten a free and fair midterm election. One such way is through his desire to illegally use the U.S. military in our elections.
After losing the 2020 election, President Trump had his Administration draft an Executive Order directing the then-Secretary of Defense to use the uniform military to seize ballots and voting machines. He has since told reporters that he regrets not signing that Executive Order.
So, last week, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth came before the Senate Armed Services Committee to answer questions about the war in Iran, the defense budget, and other matters.
Among other questions I asked was: Will you deploy the uniformed military to the polls to collect voter rolls or machines in the upcoming election?
He wouldn't answer.
**[You can read more about my line of questioning here:](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/4361?t=2&akid=2451%2E135344%2EKU_TQu)**
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/4361?t=3&akid=2451%2E135344%2EKU_TQu)
We've never had uniformed military deployed to our polls. Not in WWII, not after 9/11 ... we've never done it before.
I understand that Hegseth knows President Trump was watching the hearing and that he needs to perform for him, but, at the end of the day, he is the guy in charge of the military. He needs to make clear that he understands his role is not not loyalty to the president, but actually to protect the institution we all care about -- the uniformed military.
But he refuses to do so.
Please click on the link to the news article above for more information.
Thanks,
Elissa

* * *

👋🏻 **Wait, before you click away!** 🇺🇸
As one of the few Senators who won a Senate race in the same state won by Trump, Elissa Slotkin is being asked to campaign for other Democrats in tough races across the country this election.
And while Elissa wishes we did not have to send another email asking you to contribute, that is what we have to do today.
The outcome of this election will determine whether we are able to put a check on President Trump during the final two years of his term. We have to take back the House and the Senate. And we need your help to get it done.
[**Can Elissa count on you to make a contribution of $10 or whatever you can afford before our April fundraising drive ends? clean_body: By the 47th President no less! | | | | EXCLUSIVE OFFER FROM THE DESK OF DONALD J. TRUMP Peter, President Trump requests your presence in the 47th President Founders Club. You’re not asleep! But yes, most people would dream of receiving an email like this one. I personally created the 47th President Founders Club for one reason only: To permanently honor the patriots who founded and carried the entire MAGA movement from Day One! The ones who never wavered, never surrendered, and refused to let them destroy our country twice. I had my team pull the very best files, millions of patriot names, and I went through them myself. Your name rose straight to the top. ** That’s why I’m personally inviting you to become a Charter Member of my 47th President Founders Club. Only a few spots exist in the entire country. I’m holding one for you! ** Don’t miss your shot to stand with the patriots who made the greatest comeback in American history. Your name could be one of them. I am counting on you especially at this very moment in time. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

# [We fought for reproductive freedom. We can't take it for granted.](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=196808549&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk2ODA4NTQ5LCJpYXQiOjE3NzgxOTUxMzUsImV4cCI6MTc4MDc4NzEzNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ScX7xUmwYUn6VZUaEJfl7mwkJ3z6Ze84FyAadyj38nA)
### This fight isn't over, and we're not backing down.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| May 7
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL3dlLWZvdWdodC1mb3ItcmVwcm9kdWN0aXZlLWZyZWVkb20_.QyCTlKnBt44c14zDbseucQkDTosl-vGL9gs4NbrxAac?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/we-fought-for-reproductive-freedom?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Folks,
When even this conservative-majority Supreme Court sees the mifepristone ban for what it is - reckless, dangerous, wrong - you know the far-right has gone too far.
Here's what is happening:
Last week, far-right judges tried to upend the FDA approval process and strip access to mifepristone, the safe and effective abortion pill.
Now, the Supreme Court has paused that ruling. _But only temporarily_.
The order once again allows folks seeking abortions to obtain the pill at pharmacies or through the mail - without having to go through an in-person visit to a doctor. It will remain in effect temporarily.
**[Now this is good news, I won't downplay that. But it's far from a big win.](https://substack.com/redirect/b56ead8a-c12d-4cfa-bb55-70d965b87b35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Because all the while, far-right special interest groups are doing everything in their power to completely BAN abortion across the nation - and Michigan is ground zero for their efforts.
Anti-abortion Republicans and their allies are pouring _millions_ of dollars into this race, trying to flip Michigan's Senate seat red so they can roll back reproductive rights nationwide.
They're launching door-to-door campaigns and ads to support my MAGA opponent, Mike Rogers, because they know that if he's elected, he'll do everything in his power to pass a near-total abortion ban. And they're even running ads attacking me for supporting our freedoms.
**Here in Michigan, we 've fought to protect reproductive freedom, and we can't take it for granted.**
This fight isn't over. I refuse to back down, and I hope I can count on you to join me. Because none of us can afford to sit on the sidelines at this urgent moment, folks.
If the MAGA GOP has made one thing clear, it's that they won't stop here. There's no doubt in my mind that they're angling for a nationwide abortion ban, and we must take that threat seriously now, before it's too late.
If you believe abortion is health care, reproductive freedom is a fundamental right, and politicians should stay out of personal health care decisions, [then will you chip in $30 - or any amount - to support my campaign to fight back and keep Michigan blue?](https://substack.com/redirect/b56ead8a-c12d-4cfa-bb55-70d965b87b35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b56ead8a-c12d-4cfa-bb55-70d965b87b35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In solidarity,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b56ead8a-c12d-4cfa-bb55-70d965b87b35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

I was born in Camden, Arkansas, as the third of three children to my parents, Olive and Charles Tuberville. They raised me to consistently work hard and stand on principle, which I've brought with me every step of my life.

I met my wife, Suzanne, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans in 1989. We married three years later and have two amazing children, Tucker and Troy. _**They continue to make me proud every single day.**_

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=79728e36159946e089c06c05434f93a4&_e=4QJHk4ugUZXyr83lqwzu9gkIMombRX6nwteDpvaAZ6OY2jcsewqWnVp9eCjzgPzQiawIH797l5DSpQa7XO-jsHUUT-lqv_e1JjDqEdzeKps67BNczGMh_rO7_FdOsdY9H6nhjaImPHwgQ-Ezn5ZqxNRLQ9ushUcgrPKgCTsy4TCmFOrhcfZnhVaRdpp0diW1dUsgdyNmWk_AnNQSFA0fGDnZDEyeiuZdC-vmGoSIYLH5owKWGuxNBW37UGE3Bl3jXX0wHAv1DROYQn1bMg0RsLu3twwlAeKUD-S7AAVAR6Py5z83KaAd2bTXgGKBhRiCdh-R2xA4cKPlh_8HYoQwJE8gB4mSOlpkh2al9nu5aNW69itDQTMnndNq0dF4SnI7qw9C9ylCOaMsc86i2cOml5ZuW-nlsGaPnEWUNjCm9TNZod9rAhpuU-lAZ7_p5q8Sh4S-DLPr1B_N-yZjmV6eSw2EyrzHhJP3H1uiSBA1FSgDRBk2VQo-hl_9_nc9xDi3J01ebCRwP-rUG3ak-MiY6iXfsh6OduOWQ5duBGD86-XG23qO_hrRSthvQ8NSRizI)
After graduating from SAU, I took my first coaching job at Hermitage High School before graduating to the college level as an assistant coach at Arkansas State University.

Just two years later, I started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, where I went on to become their defensive coordinator. By the time I left the U, we had created one of the most storied programs in college football history. We won three AP national championships, and I coached future Hall-of-Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=79728e36159946e089c06c05434f93a4&_e=4QJHk4ugUZXyr83lqwzu9gkIMombRX6nwteDpvaAZ6OY2jcsewqWnVp9eCjzgPzQiawIH797l5DSpQa7XO-jsHUUT-lqv_e1JjDqEdzeKps67BNczGMh_rO7_FdOsdY9H6nhjaImPHwgQ-Ezn5ZqxNRLQ9ushUcgrPKgCTsy4TCmFOrhcfZnhVaRdpp0diW1X6CTPGvHI2m4qdygtgAwv8eQXfSpZOBSr2wfLBlGOWyZd8damcdCfRUhSzF9r81aVkW_JDor_C-1uuHGRJttICU_4cXglKZXDFnJRFD-7nAVuZ1RPf3l7O9ehJEPalv-rSg0NGtbjfglx2mznngGfRFW-OgZmyIUuyhsYsfR6PHjQNgCX9yCabe9p0gaP_PfEbGW5VMesRQKGJ1WmhgTyagynLM_TrsYk1Eg96deZTdzofgrIre9fZCcb47n1uFIkFVamUjP-cLyHjo4_oByqUgD6THe8q4v_4sZ7A2F4osu8bC6GmSAfGOPLzrq3ArWz_PBcRLqpirEEM2fXF-PnbR5RPIZHW31OeiLz2-_WBWGXf9-7IOUuI9EiLNfwWjs)
I spent a short stint as the head coach for Ole Miss before becoming the head coach for the Auburn Tigers in 1998. I solidified my career there, making eight consecutive bowl appearances, winning five SEC Western Division Titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004 when I was named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year, among other awards.

I continued coaching at Texas Tech University and the University of Cincinnati until I retired from coaching in 2016 as one of the top 50 most-winning college football coaches of all time. But I wasn't done winning just yet.

**In 2020, I went from Coach Tuberville to Senator Tuberville. After talking to my fellow Alabamians, I was enlightened by President Trump's concerns about the direction of our country, and I decided to do something about it. I ran for the United States Senate and won.**

**Throughout my time in Washington, D.C., I 've fought nonstop on President Trump's behalf.** Whether it was fighting back against the countless witch-hunts, challenging the Biden-Harris Administration's Radical and harmful policies, or working with President Trump to secure our border, protect women in sports, and make our military prioritize readiness over wokeness, I always worked hard. I stood on principle, just like my folks taught me at a young age.

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=79728e36159946e089c06c05434f93a4&_e=4QJHk4ugUZXyr83lqwzu9gkIMombRX6nwteDpvaAZ6OY2jcsewqWnVp9eCjzgPzQiawIH797l5DSpQa7XO-jsHUUT-lqv_e1JjDqEdzeKps67BNczGMh_rO7_FdOsdY9H6nhjaImPHwgQ-Ezn5ZqxNRLQ9ushUcgrPKgCTsy4TCmFOrhcfZnhVaRdpp0diW1dpsF5Jk8N1vv4-h7QVh3M5MQhuYCKmqMC18ExcL0dM48dPaB_zIFFdWFGMxQIgEpGSpOjxkU-jg5YY-qoCCZdu1UkBOr9NRnq-C_s6fq9J-onXaPg1_TMdKLwE5gozJ4e9ZZnvzCnlxsEbaZtdMgLXa_7ocUjMZhgryc1RpAHQdXRmlRYgpY8y1Tpr4d1neKMNPv23LsgMx94ZnrrGbZ8nYECP95q085R9bvhhuoPO4Hw-Bmt5EesJT3sAhq7HiUN95q3xwF-NITcLN11A3s6gX1ns5_KBaKhgzlYPM6Cu49t_d4t6jaViLXuUt6UXsN5d-jaiyNHEXXawhagWaL06dSw3bDzzWLAuXoseA4Z0xtyoXLZgqYOqVuH_MLX1QI)

We have less than two weeks to fight back against this last-minute attack. | | | Peter — From the corrupt Supreme Court to attacks on voting rights, Republican attacks on the midterm elections are in full swing. Now it looks like they’re trying to tilt the playing field in Democratic primaries. **Today, a brand-new dark money super PAC announced a massive last-minute ad buy of at least $500,000 in attack ads against Bob Brooks, the Working Families Party-endorsed firefighter and union leader running for Congress in Pennsylvania’s 7th district. 1** The super PAC was created just days ago and very likely will not have to disclose its donors until after Election Day. But we already have some clues. According to Punchbowl News, the source code of the PAC’s website links to the Republican fundraising platform WinRed,2 which has been under scrutiny for misleading donors to Republican campaigns.3 **Bob Brooks was already facing off against some of the worst anti-worker elements in the Democratic Party. Now it looks like he’s facing a last-minute deluge of attacks from _Republicans_ who know he is the only Democrat who can flip this seat blue in November — and want to stop him before he does.** [**We have less than two weeks to fight back against this last-minute attack, and we’re going to do it by reaching and talking to as many voters as possible. clean_body: We have less than two weeks to fight back against this last-minute attack. | | | Peter — From the corrupt Supreme Court to attacks on voting rights, Republican attacks on the midterm elections are in full swing. Now it looks like they’re trying to tilt the playing field in Democratic primaries. Today, a brand-new dark money super PAC announced a massive last-minute ad buy of at least $500,000 in attack ads against Bob Brooks, the Working Families Party-endorsed firefighter and union leader running for Congress in Pennsylvania’s 7th district. 1 The super PAC was created just days ago and very likely will not have to disclose its donors until after Election Day. But we already have some clues. According to Punchbowl News, the source code of the PAC’s website links to the Republican fundraising platform WinRed,2 which has been under scrutiny for misleading donors to Republican campaigns.3 Bob Brooks was already facing off against some of the worst anti-worker elements in the Democratic Party. Now it looks like he’s facing a last-minute deluge of attacks from Republicans who know he is the only Democrat who can flip this seat blue in November — and want to stop him before he does. Bob Brooks is being targeted by disingenuous attack ads funded by dark money because Republicans know he is the only candidate who can flip this seat. His background as a working-class union leader and firefighter shows why he is exactly the kind of candidate that Republicans fear — and the kind that billionaire donors will do anything to try and stop. Bob spent 20 years as a firefighter in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. Raised by a single mom, he worked as a dishwasher, warehouse worker, and snowplow driver before dedicating his life to public service. Now, as President of the Pennsylvania Professional Fire Fighters Association, he represents more than 8,000 firefighters across the Commonwealth, fighting for fair wages, healthcare, and safe working conditions. Unlike his corporate-funded opponents on both sides of the aisle, Bob doesn’t take corporate PAC money. He’s running to raise the minimum wage, tax billionaires to fund what working families need, and get big money out of politics so our government answers to the people, not wealthy donors. There’s a reason Republicans and billionaires are so scared of candidates like Bob Brooks. It’s because they know that he will stand up to Trump and fight for working people. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , @RyanGrim on Twitter , May 7, 2026 2\. , @AllyMutnick on Twitter , May 7, 2026 3\. , Al Jazeera , July 31, 2024 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. subject: The Supreme Court just gutted the Voting Rights Act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Last week, the Supreme Court handed down a decision that effectively guts what remains of the Voting Rights Act.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3230%2E21716%2Ec9UF_a)
**Last week, the Supreme Court handed down a decision that effectively guts what remains of the Voting Rights Act — the crowning achievement of the Civil Rights Movement.**
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260507-1.Z0YpJk&refcode=em20260507-3230&t=2&akid=3230%2E21716%2Ec9UF_a)
It’s a shameful, partisan decision that will have real consequences for our democracy. It means fewer protections against voter suppression, more opportunities for politicians to gerrymander distrikes, and weaker representation for communities of color in Congress.
**It undermines the core promise of our democracy: that every voice matters and every vote counts.**
Let’s be clear: Republicans would not be pursuing every possible pathway to gerrymander, redistrict, and suppress voters if they were confident in their policies. They are doing this because they are afraid of what happens when voters see how these policies have failed them.
Justice Kagan said it plainly in her dissent: Congress — the people’s representatives — should decide whether the Voting Rights Act is still needed. Not the Supreme Court. And she’s right.
That’s why in Congress, I’m fighting to protect the power of every American’s vote, and I will keep pushing for legislation to restore and strengthen the Voting Rights Act. But I can’t do it alone.
[**If you’re with me, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today to help me fight back and protect our democracy?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260507-1.Z0YpJk&refcode=em20260507-3230&amount=5&t=3&akid=3230%2E21716%2Ec9UF_a)

Sarah McBride

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2240%2E5691347%2E_muoWq)

Hi Peter, it’s Jon. I only have a few minutes, but I needed to reach out about this.
The Supreme Court just made a decision to strike down a Louisiana Congressional map, delivering a direct and brutal blow to the Voting Rights Act.
**_This is the latest in a decades-long extreme-right-wing campaign to dismantle the legacy of the Civil Rights Movement._**
Peter, of all the freedoms at stake, none is more powerful or precious than the right to vote.
And in Georgia, we know better than anyone that the Election Deniers are on the march.
The Fulton County raid, the executive order attacking voting, the MAGA loyalists on our state election board ... they've made their plans very clear.
Why the obsession with Georgia? Well, Donald Trump is a committed lifelong racist who cannot wrap his head around the fact that Black voters and Black political power in the American South were responsible for his defeat in the 2020 election.
Here’s the truth: Yes, the Trump presidency has failed. He’s massively unpopular.
But a cornered rat is even more dangerous.
Now is no time to be complacent.
Georgia is still the most competitive and crucial battleground state in the United States. _And the continuous attacks on voting rights speak to how important these Senate races are._
Because if he maintains Senate control, Trump will put more MAGA loyalists on the Supreme Court to serve for generations. That could be the most durable legacy of the Trump presidency. And when it comes to Supreme Court nominees, every single vote in the Senate matters.
_We need to fight for every single seat in the Senate to ensure that we can defeat fanatical MAGA loyalists Trump will appoint to the Court. Unchecked, MAGA will further dismantle the civil rights and voting rights laws that so much was sacrificed to achieve._
That’s why this November, we need to be prepared for a mobilization so massive and a defense of voting rights so fierce that no plot against the franchise can foil the will of the people.

Jon

Patriot,

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. clean_body: ...this may be our last chance to honor them| | | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes.
